https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.summary: Suspected bandits have killed a 37-year-old Chinese national, Wang Tingjian, who worked with Zurfi Mining Company, and his police escort, Inspector Abba Ya’u, attached to MOPOL 34, Gombe State, in an ambush in Bauchi State. Confirming the incident to Channels Television in a telephone interview on Monday, the Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), SP Nafiu Habib, said the Chinese miner was conducting a survey at a mining site when he and his escort were attacked by suspected gunmen.
https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.summary_zh: 涉嫌武装劫匪在包奇州伏击并杀害了一名在 Zurfi Mining Company 工作的37岁中国籍男子王廷健，以及其警察护送人员、隶属贡贝州 MOPOL 34 的阿巴·亚乌督察。周一，警方公共关系官（PPRO）纳菲乌·哈比卜警司在电话采访中向 Channels Television 证实了此事。他说，这名中国矿工当时正在一处采矿点开展勘测工作，他和护送人员随后遭涉嫌持枪歹徒袭击。
https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.body: Suspected bandits have killed a 37-year-old Chinese national, Wang Tingjian, who worked with Zurfi Mining Company, and his police escort, Inspector Abba Ya’u, attached to MOPOL 34, Gombe State, in an ambush in Bauchi State. The incident occurred on Saturday at about 1:30 p.m. in Ruga Village, Gwana District, Alkaleri Local Government Area of the state. Confirming the incident to Channels Television in a telephone interview on Monday, the Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), SP Nafiu Habib, said the Chinese miner was conducting a survey at a mining site when he and his escort were attacked by suspected gunmen. He explained that the attack triggered an exchange of gunfire between the security operatives and the assailants. “During the survey, they were ambushed by unknown gunmen. The Chinese national had even run towards the vehicle conveying them for safety, but they were overwhelmed,” Habib said. According to the PPRO, the victims were rushed to the Federal Teaching Hospital, Gombe, where they were confirmed dead and their bodies deposited in the hospital’s mortuary. Habib further disclosed that the anti-kidnapping unit and the Violent Crime Response Unit, in collaboration with the military and local vigilantes, were conducting a manhunt for the attackers. He added that security agencies were also working to unravel the circumstances surrounding the incident. https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.title_zh: 包奇州匪徒杀害一名37岁中国矿工和一名警察督察
https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.body_zh: 疑似武装分子在包奇州伏击了 Zurfi Mining Company 员工、37岁的中国籍男子王廷剑及其警察护送人员。护送人员是贡贝州 MOPOL 34 的阿巴·亚乌（Abba Ya’u）警监。事件发生于星期六下午约1时30分，地点是该州阿尔卡莱里地方政府辖区格瓦纳区鲁加村。警方公共关系官（PPRO）、纳菲乌·哈比卜（SP Nafiu Habib）星期一接受Channels Television电话采访时确认了此事。他说，这名中国矿工当时正在一处矿场进行勘测，他与护送人员遭到疑似持枪分子袭击。他解释道，袭击引发了安全人员与袭击者之间的交火。哈比卜说：“勘测期间，他们遭到不明持枪分子伏击。这名中国公民甚至跑向接送他们的车辆寻求安全，但他们仍被压制。”据PPRO介绍，遇害者被紧急送往贡贝联邦教学医院，经确认已经死亡，遗体被送往医院太平间。哈比卜进一步透露，反绑架小组和暴力犯罪应对小组正与军方及当地民防人员合作，追捕袭击者。他补充说，安全机构也在努力查清事件背后的具体情况。持续了解 NAIJA CONNECT 每周发现国内进展和世界卓越成就的故事

https://leadership.ng/rep-bichi-receives.summary: The defectors, who also included the NDC treasurer, Mannir Umar, ward secretaries, women and youth leaders, as well as members of the Kwankwasiyya movement , formally announced their decision during a visit to Bichi at the lawmaker’s office. Speaking on behalf of the defectors, the Chairman of the Forum and Danzabuwa Ward Chairman, Abdulkadir Lawan, said their decision to join the APC was influenced by Bichi’s developmental projects and empowerment programmes.
https://leadership.ng/rep-bichi-receives.summary_zh: 脱党者还包括民族民主党（NDC）财务主管曼尼尔·乌马尔、选区书记、妇女和青年领袖，以及Kwankwasiyya运动成员。他们在这名议员位于比奇办公室访问期间，正式宣布加入全尼日利亚人民大会党（APC）。脱党者代表、论坛主席兼丹扎布瓦选区主席阿卜杜勒卡迪尔·拉万表示，他们加入全尼日利亚人民大会党（APC）的决定受到了比奇发展项目和赋权计划的影响。
https://leadership.ng/rep-bichi-receives.body: The defectors, who also included the NDC treasurer, Mannir Umar, ward secretaries, women and youth leaders, as well as members of the Kwankwasiyya movement , formally announced their decision during a visit to Bichi at the lawmaker’s office. The five ward chairmen represented Waire, Danzabuwa, Kaukau, Muntsira and Bichi wards. Speaking on behalf of the defectors, the Chairman of the Forum and Danzabuwa Ward Chairman, Abdulkadir Lawan, said their decision to join the APC was influenced by Bichi’s developmental projects and empowerment programmes. Lawan said he personally benefited from the lawmaker’s scholarship initiative, which enabled him to obtain a master’s degree, adding that he was currently pursuing a PhD through the Abubakar Kabir Foundation. He also cited alleged poor coordination, lack of respect for members and leadership disagreements within the NDC in Kano State as reasons for their departure. Receiving the defectors, Bichi welcomed them into the APC, expressing appreciation for their confidence in his leadership and describing their decision as a boost to the party’s grassroots mobilisation. The lawmaker highlighted some of his interventions in Danzabuwa Ward, including the construction of a primary school, ongoing road projects and provision of boreholes. He urged party members to remain united and intensify grassroots mobilisation to secure victory for President Bola Tinubu, Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf and other APC candidates in the 2027 general elections. The defection ceremony was attended by the APC member representing Bichi Constituency in the Kano State House of Assembly, Lawan Shehu Bichi; the Director-General of the campaign council, Sani Mukaddas Bichi; the Bichi Local Government Vice Chairman, Babangida Danzabuwa; and the APC State Secretary, Prof. Yusuf Muhammad Sabo. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.title: Listed Oil & Gas Firms Declare N11.8tn Revenue Amid Hike in Oil Price
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.summary: Following the increase in global oil prices, Aradel Holdings Plc and five other oil & Gas companies listed on the Nigeria Exchange Limited (NGX) declared an estimated N11.8trillion revenue in nine months ended September 30, 2026. While upstream producers such as Seplat and Aradel Holdings benefit directly from improved crude oil price realisations and production, downstream marketers remain exposed to the cost of petroleum products, distribution expenses, financing charges and changes in market prices.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.summary_zh: 随着全球油价上涨，Aradel Holdings Plc及另外五家在尼日利亚证券交易所（NGX）上市的石油和天然气公司宣布，截至2026年9月30日的九个月合计预估收入为11.8万亿尼日利亚奈拉。Seplat和Aradel Holdings等上游生产商直接受益于原油实现价格和产量的提高，而下游销售商仍面临石油产品成本、分销费用、融资费用以及市场价格变化的冲击。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.body: Following the increase in global oil prices, Aradel Holdings Plc and five other oil & Gas companies listed on the Nigeria Exchange Limited (NGX) declared an estimated N11.8trillion revenue in nine months ended September 30, 2026. This represents 58.7 per cent increase when compared to N7.44 trillion reported in in the corresponding period of 2025. In the period under review, the six companies posted N2.06 trillion profit before tax, about 72.7 per cent increase over N1.19 trillion reported in the corresponding period of 2025. The earnings trend, however, showed that the benefits of higher oil prices are not uniform across the industry. While upstream producers such as Seplat and Aradel Holdings benefit directly from improved crude oil price realisations and production, downstream marketers remain exposed to the cost of petroleum products, distribution expenses, financing charges and changes in market prices. The breakdown of revenue revealed that Aradel Holdings posted revenue of N3.94trillion nine months ended September 30, 2026, about 633 per cent increase from N538.8 billion reported in nine months ended September 30, 2025. The company said the growth in revenue reflected the consolidation of ND Western and Renaissance, higher production and a firmer commodity price environment (average realised prices of $97.5/bbl and $2.64/mscf vs nine months of 2025: US$75.6/bbl and US$1.64/mscf). Aradel Holdings added that crude oil contributed 69per cent of revenue, gas 26per cent and refined products five per cent. With the significant increase in revenue, Aradel Holdings posted a profit before tax of N764.7 billion in nine months of 2026, about 154.3per cent increase from N300.7 billion reported in nine months of 2025. The Board, thus approved an interim dividend of N7.00 per share for the nine-month period ended 2026 (nine months of 2025: N10.00 per share), amounting to approximately N30.4 billion. Chief Executive Officer, Aradel Holdings’ Adegbite Falade, said: “The first nine months of 2026 demonstrated what our enlarged portfolio can deliver. Group production ran above our full-year guidance range, with strong growth in both crude oil and gas output. This drove a step-change in revenue and EBITDA, alongside improved margins.” The company raised its full-year 2026 production guidance to an average 140,000–150,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, from the previous range of 110,000–140,000, following stronger-than-expected production during the nine-month period. Similarly, Seplat Energy announced N3.78 trillion revenue in nine months of 2026, about 12.5 per cent growth from N3.36 trillion reported in nine months of 2025, while Oando posted N2.8trillion revenue, a 9.2 per cent increase over N2.54 trillion recorded in 2025. On its part, Totalenergies Marketing Nigeria announced N661.92billion revenue, a growth of 12.6 per cent from N587.6 billion in 2025 . Eterna Plc reported N365.6 billion revenue, representing an increase of 72 per cent over N212.8 billion in nine months of 2025. Eterna benefited from higher sales and improved gross profit, which rose to N23.33 billion from N9.94 billion. In addition, Conoil declared N280.12 billion revenue , about 37.4 per cent increase when compared to N203.8 billion reported in nine months of 2025. The results also showed that the companies recorded varying levels of growth, with Seplat accounting for the largest share of the combined profit and revenue, while Eterna recorded the highest percentage increase in profit after tax. Operators noted that the performance of the companies reflected different factors across the oil and gas value chain. Seplat’s improved earnings were supported by higher production and improved oil price realisations, while Conoil benefited from growth in its white petroleum products business. Commenting on the performance of listed oil and gas companies, analysts at Zedcrest Investment Managers noted that stronger crude oil prices played a major role in supporting the sector’s earnings, although the improvement in production volumes had been less significant across some operators. They identified stable foreign exchange conditions and expectations of improved oil production as factors that could support the sector’s performance in the final quarter of the year. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.body_zh: 在全球油价上涨后，Aradel Holdings Plc及另外5家在Nigeria Exchange Limited（NGX）上市的石油与天然气公司宣布，截至2026年9月30日的9个月估算收入为11.8万亿尼日利亚奈拉。与2025年同期报告的7.44万亿尼日利亚奈拉相比，增长了58.7%。在报告期，这6家公司实现税前利润2.06万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年同期报告的1.19万亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约72.7%。然而，盈利走势显示，高油价带来的收益并未在整个行业均匀分布。Seplat和Aradel Holdings等上游生产商直接受益于原油实现价格和产量的改善，而下游销售商仍面临石油产品成本、分销费用、融资成本以及市场价格变化的冲击。收入明细显示，Aradel Holdings截至2026年9月30日的9个月实现收入3.94万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较截至2025年9月30日的9个月报告的5388亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约633%。公司表示，收入增长反映了ND Western与Renaissance合并、产量提高以及大宗商品价格环境走强（平均实现价格为每桶97.5美元、每千标准立方英尺2.64美元，而2025年前9个月分别为每桶75.6美元和每千标准立方英尺1.64美元）。Aradel Holdings补充称，原油贡献收入的69%，天然气占26%，成品油占5%。随着收入大幅增长，Aradel Holdings在2026年前9个月实现税前利润7647亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月报告的3007亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约154.3%。因此，董事会批准截至2026年的9个月期间派发每股7.00尼日利亚奈拉的中期股息（2025年前9个月为每股10.00尼日利亚奈拉），总额约304亿尼日利亚奈拉。Aradel Holdings首席执行官Adegbite Falade表示：“2026年前9个月展示了我们扩大后的资产组合所能创造的成果。集团产量高于全年指引区间，原油和天然气产量均实现强劲增长。这推动收入和EBITDA实现跃升，同时利润率也有所改善。”在9个月期间产量强于预期后，公司将2026年全年产量指引从此前的每日11万至14万桶油当量上调至平均每日14万至15万桶油当量。同样，Seplat Energy宣布2026年前9个月收入为3.78万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月报告的3.36万亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约12.5%；Oando实现收入2.8万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年录得的2.54万亿尼日利亚奈拉增长9.2%。Totalenergies Marketing Nigeria宣布收入为6619.2亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年的5876亿尼日利亚奈拉增长12.6%。Eterna Plc报告收入为3656亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月的2128亿尼日利亚奈拉增长72%。Eterna受益于销量提高和毛利润改善，毛利润从99.4亿尼日利亚奈拉升至233.3亿尼日利亚奈拉。此外，Conoil宣布收入为2801.2亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月报告的2038亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约37.4%。业绩还显示，各公司的增长水平不一，Seplat占合计利润和收入的最大份额，而Eterna的税后利润增幅最高。运营商指出，这些公司的业绩反映了石油与天然气价值链中不同因素的影响。Seplat盈利改善得益于产量提高和油价实现水平提升，而Conoil则受益于白色石油产品业务增长。Zedcrest Investment Managers分析师在评论上市石油与天然气公司的业绩时表示，原油价格走强在支撑该行业盈利方面发挥了重要作用，尽管部分运营商的产量增幅相对有限。他们认为，汇率环境稳定以及对石油产量改善的预期，可能支撑该行业在本年最后一个季度的表现。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛中产阶级、在所有平台上均可获取的最具权威性的新闻媒体，同时为有志之士和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报是公共信托媒体，专注于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交叉议题。您可以发送邮件至hello@thisdaylive.com或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://leadership.ng/bandits-kill-chine.body: The incident occurred on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at Ruga Village in Gwana District, where the Chinese national was reportedly engaged in core drilling activities as part of a mining site survey. The Bauchi State Police Command confirmed the attack, saying the company vehicle conveying the expatriate was ambushed by suspected bandits while security personnel were escorting him. The Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), SP Nafiu Habib, while confirming the incident in a telephone conversation with LEADERSHIP on Monday, explaining that the attack resulted in an exchange of gunfire between the security operatives and the assailants. “Yes, it is true that the incident occurred on Saturday. The team was ambushed, and following an exchange of gunfire between the security personnel escorting the miner and the assailants, the miner and one police officer lost their lives,” he said. Habib disclosed that the incident took place in Gwana District while the mining team was in the area to conduct a survey at a mining site. The police inspector, identified as Yau Abba, was attached to the Mobile Police Force (MOPOL) 34 and deployed to provide security for the Chinese national. According to the report, efforts were ongoing to track down and arrest those responsible for the attack, while security agencies were working to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.body: The Minister of State for Defence, Dr Bello Matawalle, has received the former Zamfara State Deputy Governorship aspirant of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Hon. Umar Abubakar Gwashi, and six other politicians who defected to the All Progressives Congress (APC). The defectors, who are members of the Tanimu Turaki-led faction of the PDP, comprise two National Assembly aspirants and four State House of Assembly aspirants. They were received by Matawalle at his residence in Maradun, Zamfara State. According to a statement issued by the Publicity Secretary of the Matawalle Political Standing Committee (MPSC), Malam Yusuf Idris Gusau, the other defectors are Hon. Abubakar Abdullahi Makama, PDP aspirant for Gummi/Bukkuyum Federal Constituency, and Hon. Lukman M. Shehu, who contested for the party’s ticket for Kaura Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency. The four State Assembly aspirants are Hon. Ibrahim Abdullahi, Maradun II State Constituency; Hon. Sani Garba Danjibga, Tsafe West State Constituency; Hon. Usman Abdullahi, Talata Mafara South State Constituency; and Hon. Umar Mande Falale, Gummi East State Constituency. Receiving the defectors, Matawalle expressed delight over their decision to join the APC, saying their defection had further strengthened the party’s political base in Zamfara State ahead of the 2027 general election. He described Gwashi as an experienced politician who had been active in politics since the old Sokoto State, where he served as a member of the House of Assembly, before holding various elective positions in Zamfara State. The minister said Gwashi remained a respected political figure in his constituency and across the state. Matawalle urged the new APC members to intensify grassroots mobilisation for President Bola Tinubu and other candidates of the party ahead of the 2027 elections. He also assured them of equal opportunities in the party’s activities, while commending their decision to join the APC. Speaking on behalf of the defectors, Gwashi said they chose to join the APC through Matawalle because of what he described as the minister’s honesty, reliability and commitment to political relationships. He attributed their decision to leave the PDP to the party’s lingering internal crisis, which he said had undermined the political ambitions and future of many members, including those seeking elective positions. Gwashi also commended Matawalle for his efforts in mobilising support for President Tinubu and the APC across the country. He pledged that the defectors would mobilise support for Tinubu at the grassroots to ensure his re-election in 2027. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.body_zh: 国防部长办公室常任国务部长贝洛·马塔瓦勒博士接见了人民民主党（PDP）前扎姆法拉州副州长竞选人、尊敬的乌马尔·阿布巴卡尔·瓜希，以及另外六名转投全进步大会党（APC）的政治人物。这些脱离者均属于由塔尼穆·图拉基领导的PDP派系，包括两名国民议会竞选人和四名州议会竞选人。马塔瓦勒在扎姆法拉州马拉敦的住所接见了他们。马塔瓦勒政治常设委员会（MPSC）宣传秘书马利姆·尤素福·伊德里斯·古萨乌发表声明称，其他脱离者还包括古米/布库尤姆联邦选区PDP竞选人尊敬的阿布巴卡尔·阿卜杜拉希·马卡马，以及曾竞选该党考拉纳莫达/比尔宁马加吉联邦选区党籍的尊敬的卢克曼·M.谢胡。四名州议会竞选人分别是马拉敦第二州选区的尊敬的易卜拉欣·阿卜杜拉希、扎费西州选区的尊敬的萨尼·加尔巴·丹吉布加、塔拉塔马法拉南州选区的尊敬的乌斯曼·阿卜杜拉希，以及古米东州选区的尊敬的乌马尔·曼德·法拉莱。接见这些脱离者时，马塔瓦勒对他们的决定加入APC表示欢迎，称他们的倒戈进一步巩固了该党在扎姆法拉州的政治基础，为迎接2027年大选做好了准备。他形容瓜希是一位经验丰富的政治人物，自旧索科托州时期便活跃于政坛，曾担任州议会议员，之后在扎姆法拉州担任过多个民选职位。这位部长表示，瓜希在其选区乃至全州仍是一位备受尊重的政治人物。马塔瓦勒敦促这些新加入APC的人士，在2027年选举前加强基层动员，为总统博拉·蒂努布及其他该党候选人争取支持。他还保证，他们将获得参与党内活动的平等机会，同时赞扬他们加入APC的决定。瓜希代表脱离者发言称，他们通过马塔瓦勒转投APC，是因为他所说的这位部长诚实、可靠，并致力于维护政治关系。他把离开PDP的决定归因于该党长期未消的内部危机，称这场危机削弱了许多成员，包括那些寻求民选职位人士的政治抱负和未来。瓜希还赞扬马塔瓦勒为总统蒂努布和APC在全国各地动员支持所做的努力。他承诺，这些脱离者将在基层动员对蒂努布的支持，以确保他在2027年再次当选。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的意见

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has directed President Bola Tinubu’s campaign council in FCT to block opposition parties from securing 25 per cent of votes in the territory during the 16 January presidential election. Mr Wike gave the charge while inaugurating the 466-member All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council and Rainbow Coalition in FCT on Monday. The minister specifically named the opposition parties as the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC). He said the campaign team’s mandate goes beyond a simple victory to achieving an overwhelming margin for President Tinubu and APC National Assembly candidates. “We’re not talking about winning; we’re talking about winning overwhelmingly. “We must not allow them to go with 25 per cent. They don’t deserve to get 25 per cent,” Mr Wike told the gathering, which included council members, party supporters, and members of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP). Addressing claims by opposition figures regarding political dominance ahead of the 2027 polls, the minister dismissed assertions that the ADC held sway in northern states or stood a chance in the nation’s capital. He singled out the ADC’s presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, noting his tenure as vice president from 1999 to 2007, and argued that past administrations failed to deliver foundational policy reforms for the FCT. Mr Wike also challenged former Rivers governor, Rotimi Amaechi, whom he referenced in connection with opposition remarks about an APC rally in Port Harcourt, to test his party’s popularity in Rivers State. “The FCT is for no other party other than the APC,” Wike, a member of the PDP, declared, warning council members that they would be held directly accountable for the election outcome in the territory. To persuade voters, the minister urged the council to campaign on the current administration’s governance reforms and infrastructure record rather than mere promises. According to him, the Tinubu administration has introduced historic structural changes since 2023, including appointing an FCT representative to the Federal Executive Council (FEC) for the first time since Abuja’s creation in 1976 and establishing dedicated Mandate Secretariats for Women and Youth. He noted that the administration also created the FCT Civil Service Commission, appointed the first Head of Service for the FCT, and enabled career civil servants to rise to the rank of permanent secretary. He added that traditional rulers had been elevated, while road networks, police stations, and educational projects, such as the proposed University of Science and Technology in Abaji, were expanded across satellite towns and rural communities. Wike commended the leadership of the APC and PDP in the FCT for setting aside party rivalries to form the Rainbow Coalition in support of the president’s re-election and National Assembly candidates. He identified the candidates as Philip Aduda, seeking election to represent the FCT in the Senate, John Gabaya for AMAC/Bwari Federal Constituency and Danladi Chiya for Abuja South Federal Constituency. He urged other states to emulate the alliance model practised in the FCT, Rivers and Akwa Ibom. He instructed the council to establish local campaign committees across all FCT area councils and take their message directly to markets, suburbs, traditional rulers, indigenes, and non-indigene associations while maintaining peace and adherence to electoral laws. In his remarks, the FCT Chairman of the APC, Ishaku Yamawo, commended the party leadership for fostering unity across political divides and specifically recognised members of the “Rambo Coalition,” a cross-party political structure associated with the FCT minister. Mr Yamawo said the coalition’s willingness to work alongside the APC demonstrated that the party’s strength lay in building partnerships and pursuing a common political objective, adding that the developmental projects executed under Tinubu’s “Renewed Hope” agenda served as the party’s primary campaign message. “The people can see the transformation taking place,” Mr Yamawo said. He added that Mr Wike’s appointment as the coordinator of the FCT Presidential Campaign Council was a strategic decision based on his capacity for grassroots mobilisation. He pledged that the territory’s party structure was fully mobilised to deliver votes for President Tinubu and all APC National Assembly candidates, urging members to remain disciplined and sustain the prevailing atmosphere of political cooperation across all wards and polling units. Also speaking, the FCT Chairman of the PDP, Mohammed Dogara, praised Mr Wike for what he described as unbiased leadership that has united rival political camps in the capital territory. Using a local proverb, Mr Dogara commended the minister for “bringing the cat and the rat to build the house and live in the house without any issues,” noting that such collaboration between APC and PDP leaders in the FCT was unprecedented. Mr Dogara assured the minister that local council chairmen and grassroots leaders in the territory were fully capable of mobilising voters even in his absence. He expressed optimism that the coalition’s efforts would secure victory at the polls on 16 January 2027, naming Messrs. Aduda, Gabaya and Chiya as beneficiaries of the unified political front. “Come 17th of January, we are going to rejoice and celebrate the resounding victory,” he said
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 2027年：Wike责成竞选委员会，不得让Atiku和Obi在联邦首都 territory 获得25%的选票
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 联邦首都领地（FCT）部长Nyesom Wike已指示总统Bola Tinubu竞选委员会在联邦首都领地阻挠反对党在1月16日总统选举中取得25%的选票。Wike先生周一在联邦首都领地主持由466人组成的全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会和彩虹联盟成立仪式时下达了这一要求。部长明确点名反对党为非洲民主大会（ADC）和尼日利亚民主大会（NDC）。他说，竞选团队的使命不只是赢得胜利，而是要为Tinubu总统和APC国家议会候选人取得压倒性优势。“我们说的不是获胜，而是压倒性获胜。‘我们绝不能让他们拿到25%。他们不配得到25%，’”Wike先生对与会者说。出席者包括委员会成员、党内支持者以及人民民主党（PDP）成员。针对反对派人士在2027年选举前关于政治主导地位的言论，部长驳斥了ADC在北部州份占据主导地位或有可能在首都胜出的说法。他特别提到ADC总统候选人Atiku Abubakar，指出其于1999年至2007年担任副总统，并称历届政府未能为联邦首都领地实施基础性政策改革。Wike先生还向前 Rivers州州长Rotimi Amaechi提出挑战，称对方曾就反对派在Port Harcourt举行的APC集会发表言论，如今应检验其政党在Rivers州的人气。“联邦首都领地除了APC，不属于任何其他政党。”身为PDP成员的Wike宣称，并警告委员会成员，他们将直接对联邦首都领地的选举结果负责。为说服选民，部长敦促委员会围绕现任政府的治理改革和基础设施成就开展宣传，而非仅仅作出承诺。据他介绍，Tinubu政府自2023年以来推行了历史性的结构性变革，包括自1976年Abuja设立以来首次任命一名联邦首都领地代表进入联邦执行委员会（FEC），并设立专门的妇女和青年授权秘书处。他指出，该政府还设立了联邦首都领地公务员委员会，任命了联邦首都领地首任政府事务主管，并使职业公务员得以晋升至常任秘书一级。他补充说，传统统治者地位得到提升，卫星城和农村社区的道路网络、警察局以及Abaji拟建科技大学等教育项目均得到扩展。Wike赞扬联邦首都领地APC和PDP的领导层搁置党派竞争，组建彩虹联盟，以支持总统连任和国家议会候选人。他列出的候选人为争取代表联邦首都领地进入参议院的Philip Aduda、AMAC/Bwari联邦选区的John Gabaya，以及Abuja South联邦选区的Danladi Chiya。他敦促其他州仿效联邦首都领地、Rivers州和Akwa Ibom州实行的联盟模式。他指示委员会在联邦首都领地所有地方议会设立竞选委员会，将信息直接传达给市场、郊区、传统统治者、本地居民和非本地居民协会，同时维护和平并遵守选举法律。在发言中，联邦首都领地APC主席Ishaku Yamawo赞扬该党领导层推动跨越政治分歧的团结，并特别表彰了与联邦首都领地部长有关的跨党派政治组织“兰博联盟”成员。Yamawo先生说，该联盟愿意与APC合作，证明该党的力量在于建立伙伴关系并追求共同政治目标；此外，在Tinubu“恢复希望”议程下实施的发展项目，构成了该党的首要竞选信息。“人民看得见正在发生的转变。”Yamawo先生说。他补充称，任命Wike先生担任联邦首都领地总统竞选委员会协调员，是基于其基层动员能力作出的战略决定。他保证，该领地内的党组织已全面动员，将为Tinubu总统和所有APC国家议会候选人争取选票，同时敦促成员保持纪律，持续维护所有选区和投票站之间现有的政治合作氛围。联邦首都领地PDP主席Mohammed Dogara也发表讲话，称赞Wike先生实行了他所描述的不偏不倚的领导，促成了首都领地内相互对立的政治阵营团结。他引用一则当地谚语，赞扬这位部长“把猫和老鼠带到一起建房子，并让他们住进房子里而毫无矛盾”，并指出联邦首都领地APC和PDP领导人之间这种合作史无前例。Dogara先生向部长保证，即使部长不在场，地方议会主席和基层领导人也完全有能力动员选民。他乐观地表示，联盟的努力将在2027年1月16日的选举中取得胜利，并称Aduda、Gabaya和Chiya三位先生将成为统一政治阵线的受益者。“到了1月17日，我们将欢庆并庆祝这场大胜。”他说。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.body: (워싱턴=연합뉴스) 박성민 특파원 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 16일(현지시간) 오는 18∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 참석 계기에 김정은 북한 국무위원장을 만날 수도 있다고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 필리핀과 중국 등 아시아 순방을 떠나기 전 백악관에서 기자들과 만나 중국에서 "시진핑 중국 국가주석을 만날 예정"이라며 "(러시아 블라디미르) 푸틴 대통령과 만날 예정이며, 김 위원장과 만날 수도 있다"고 말했다. 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과의 재회 가능성을 언급한 것은 취재진이 질의를 시작하기 전 이번 순방 일정을 간략히 설명하는 과정에서 선제적으로 밝힌 것이다. 이는 지난주 금요일인 13일 백악관 당국자가 언론에 트럼프 대통령의 이번 순방에서 김 위원장과의 만남은 계획돼 있지 않다고 밝힌 것과는 달라진 것이다. 이에 따라 14∼15일 주말을 거치면서 상황이 변하면서 이번 APEC 정상회의를 계기로 북미 정상회담을 개최할 가능성이 좀 더 커진 것 아니냐는 관측도 나온다. 아니면 달라진 상황이 없는 데도 트럼프 대통령이 재차 김 위원장에게 이번 기회에 북미 회담을 해보자는 메시지를 던졌을 가능성도 있다. 트럼프 대통령은 김 위원장과 중국에서 만날 가능성을 얘기했지만, APEC 정상회의 개최지인 선전인지, 최근 김 위원장이 깜짝 방문했던 단둥인지 등 구체적인 장소를 밝히지 않았다. 아울러 김 위원장 방중 여부가 APEC 정상회의 주최국이자 북미회담 주선 역할을 할 수 있는 중국에 달려 있다며 공을 넘긴 것으로 미뤄볼 때 방중 기간 북미 회담 가능성을 계속 타진하며 불씨를 살려놓을 것으로 예상된다. 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과 다시 만난다면 2019년 6월 판문점에서 당시 문재인 대통령과 함께 회동한 이후 7년 5개월만에 북미회담이 이뤄지는 것이다. 트럼프 대통령은 그간 북한을 핵보유국으로 인정하는 듯한 발언을 내놓으면서 올해 안에 김 위원장과 만나고 싶다는 뜻을 공개적으로 피력해왔다. 트럼프 대통령이 이날 다시 김 위원장과의 재회 가능성을 띄운 것은 여당인 공화당이 미국 중간선거에서 참패하면서 남은 임기 2년간 급속한 레임덕에 빠지는 정치적 위기에 놓인 상황에서 내치보다는 외교를 앞세워 집권 2기의 업적을 남기려는 포석으로도 풀이된다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 필리핀 마닐라로 출발해 17∼18일 쿼드(Quad·미국, 일본, 호주, 인도의 안보협의체) 정상회의 및 미·아세안(ASEAN) 정상회의에 참석한다. 그는 이어 중국 선전으로 이동, 18∼19일 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에 참석하며, 이 기간 미·중·러 3자 정상회담도 열린다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/17 00:51 송고 2026년11월17일 00시51분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.body_zh: （华盛顿＝韩联社）特派记者朴成敏报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普16日（当地时间）表示，在18日至19日于中国举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议期间，可能会见朝鲜国务委员金正恩。特朗普总统当天在前往菲律宾和中国等亚洲国家进行访问前，在白宫向记者表示，他“预计会见中国国家主席习近平”，“预计会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，也可能会见金正恩委员长”。特朗普总统在记者开始提问前介绍此次访问行程时，主动提到了与金正恩委员长再次会面的可能性。这与白宫官员上周五13日向媒体表示，此次访问期间没有安排与金正恩委员长会面的说法有所不同。随着14日至15日周末局势发生变化，外界也开始推测，此次APEC领导人非正式会议期间举行美朝领导人会谈的可能性是否有所增加。也可能出现另一种情况，即即使局势没有变化，特朗普总统仍有意再次向金正恩委员长传达利用此次机会举行美朝会谈的信息。特朗普总统谈到可能在中国与金正恩委员长会面，但未透露具体地点，例如是APEC领导人非正式会议举办地山东，还是金正恩委员长近期突然访问过的丹东。他还表示，是否安排金正恩委员长出访中国，取决于作为APEC领导人非正式会议主办国、并可能斡旋美朝会谈的中国，因此可判断，他将继续探询访问期间举行美朝会谈的可能性，并维持这一议题的活力。如果特朗普总统再次与金正恩委员长会面将是2019年6月在板门店与当时的文在寅总统共同现身后，时隔7年5个月举行的美朝会谈。特朗普总统此前曾多次公开表示，希望在年内与金正恩委员长会面，并发表仿佛承认朝鲜为核武国家的言论。特朗普总统当天再次提出可能与金正恩委员长重逢之际，执政共和党在美国中期选举中惨败，面临在剩余两年任期内迅速陷入跛脚鸭困境的政治危机。也可将其解读为，特朗普总统没有采取守势，而是希望以外交优先，为第二个任期留下政绩。特朗普总统当天出发前往菲律宾马尼拉，将出席17日至18日举行的四方安全对话（Quad·美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度的安全磋商机制）领导人会议及美国—东盟（ASEAN）领导人会议。他随后将前往中国，出席18日至19日举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议，期间还将举行美中俄三国领导人会谈。报道可通过KakaoTalk发送给okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月17日00:51发布

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 总统办公室星期一表示，李在明总统已批准举行听证会，对法务部长候选人李勇哲和其提名的国税厅（NTS）厅长人选安德旭进行国会确认。两人的确认听证会预计将重点审议其资历，以及他们在起诉改革和税务管理等关键政府问题上的政策立场。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung has approved requests for parliamentary confirmation hearings for Justice Minister nominee Lee Yong-cheol and Ahn Duk-su, his pick to head the National Tax Service (NTS), the presidential office said Monday. Their confirmation hearings are expected to focus on their qualifications and policy positions on key government issues, including prosecution reform and tax administration. Lee Yong-cheol worked on prosecution reform while serving as senior presidential secretary for civil affairs and legal affairs under former President Roh Moo-hyun, who served from 2003 to 2008. Lee also served on the transition team after Lee Jae Myung was elected mayor of Seongnam, south of Seoul, in June 2010. Before his nomination, he headed the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA). Questions are expected to focus on allegations surrounding his role in the 2015 Daejang-dong development project, which was launched while Lee Jae Myung was mayor of Seongnam. Ahn is a career tax official with extensive experience in tax investigations and administration. He has headed the Seoul Regional Tax Office since July and previously oversaw investigations into companies suspected of tax evasion. As head of the NTS' Investigation Bureau, Ahn was recognized for cracking down on tax evasion involving stock market manipulation and other unfair trading practices that harmed retail investors. His hearing is expected to focus on his plans to promote tax fairness and strengthen efforts to combat tax evasion. The National Assembly is required to complete the hearings within 20 days of receiving the president's requests

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korean nuclear issue unlikely to feature prominently at Trump-Xi-Putin summit: experts
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: MANILA — North Korea's nuclear weapons program is unlikely to feature prominently at an unprecedented summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia set to be held this week, though the gathering could provide a limited opening for renewed diplomatic contact between Washington and Pyongyang, U.S. experts said Monday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 马尼拉——美国专家周一表示，尽管美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人本周将举行前所未有的峰会，但朝鲜的核武计划不太可能在会上成为突出议题。不过，这场聚会可能为华盛顿与平壤恢复外交接触提供有限机会。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: MANILA — North Korea's nuclear weapons program is unlikely to feature prominently at an unprecedented summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia set to be held this week, though the gathering could provide a limited opening for renewed diplomatic contact between Washington and Pyongyang, U.S. experts said Monday. U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are scheduled to hold their first-ever trilateral summit Thursday in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, where nuclear arms reduction is expected to be discussed. Although Trump has previously expressed interest in meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un again, a U.S. administration official said last week that there are no plans for engagement with Pyongyang during the president's Asia trip. The White House has not responded to a Yonhap News Agency inquiry on whether North Korea will be discussed during the trilateral summit. Andrew Yeo, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, said North Korea's nuclear program is unlikely to be discussed at the summit, citing considerable differences between Washington and Moscow over Pyongyang's nuclear ambitions. "Any mention of nuclear arms reduction from the three leaders will be a generally worded and vague statement," Yeo told Yonhap News Agency. Ellen Kim, a senior fellow at the Korea Economic Institute of America (KEI), said the three leaders might briefly discuss North Korea behind closed doors, possibly at Trump's initiative, but other issues would likely take precedence. "However, nuclear arms control among the U.S., Russia and China, along with the war in Iran, will likely take priority at the meeting," she said. Scott Snyder, president and chief executive officer (CEO) of KEI, shared a similar assessment. "I doubt that North Korea's nuclear program will be accepted as a discussion topic among the three leaders," Snyder said. Despite the limited prospects for substantive discussions on North Korea, some suggest the summit could create an indirect opening for renewed diplomatic engagement between Trump and Kim. Yeo said the trilateral meeting itself would not have much bearing on a Trump-Kim meeting but noted that Kim may consider a future meeting with Trump if he views the trilateral gathering positively. Kim of KEI said the summit could, at best, help open diplomatic channels between Washington and Pyongyang, but is unlikely to lead directly to renewed engagement between Trump and the North Korean leader. "Xi and Putin could convey Trump's messages to Kim," she said. "But they may be reluctant to support U.S.-North Korea negotiations for fear of losing their influence over North Korea." Sydney Seiler, a former U.S. national intelligence officer for North Korea, suggested Xi and Putin could encourage Trump to continue reaching out to Pyongyang and consider incentives, including possible sanctions relief, without assuming a direct mediating role. "It is most unlikely that either Xi or Putin is interested in taking a more active role in mediating a U.S.-DPRK summit," Seiler said, referring to North Korea by its official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The experts generally dismissed comparisons between the upcoming summit and the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union discussed the postwar international order without the participation of other countries directly affected by their decisions. Robert Rapson, a former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea, described such comparisons as misleading and said major differences among the three countries would make meaningful agreements difficult. "Unlike Yalta, this meeting is not deciding the world order," Rapson said. "It's largely symbolic and performative, albeit not without some consequences." Despite expectations of limited substantive results, Rapson warned that U.S. allies, including South Korea, should closely monitor the discussions to ensure their security interests are not compromised. "As for allies and partners, including Seoul, they are somewhat out in the cold and will have to look to Trump's key senior advisers, to the extent possible, to keep them apprised of developments and to help ensure the president does not go off the rails with respect to their core interests," Rapson said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 专家称，朝鲜核问题不太可能在特朗普、习近平和普京峰会上占据突出位置
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 马尼拉消息：美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人定于本周举行的史无前例峰会不太可能重点讨论朝鲜核武计划，不过美国专家周一表示，这次会晤可能为华盛顿与平壤恢复外交接触提供有限机会。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京定于周四在中国深圳举行首次三方峰会，地点安排在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间，届时预计将讨论削减核武的问题。尽管特朗普此前曾表示有兴趣再次会见朝鲜领导人金正恩，但美国政府官员上周表示，总统亚洲之行期间没有与平壤接触的计划。白宫尚未回应韩联社关于三方峰会是否会讨论朝鲜问题的询问。布鲁金斯学会高级研究员安德鲁·约表示，由于华盛顿与莫斯科对平壤核野心存在巨大分歧，朝鲜核计划不太可能在峰会上成为讨论议题。约对韩联社说：“三位领导人若提及削减核武，措辞通常会较为笼统和模糊。”美国韩国经济研究院（KEI）高级研究员艾伦·金表示，三位领导人可能会在闭门会议上简要讨论朝鲜问题，也可能是由特朗普主动提出，但其他议题很可能更受重视。她说：“不过，美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的核军备控制，以及伊朗战争，预计将在会议期间占据优先位置。”KEI总裁兼首席执行官斯科特·斯奈德也作出了类似评估。斯奈德说：“我怀疑朝鲜核计划会被列为三位领导人的讨论议题。”尽管就朝鲜问题展开实质性讨论的前景有限，但一些人认为，此次峰会可能为特朗普与金正恩恢复外交接触创造间接机会。约表示，三方会议本身不会对特朗普与金正恩会晤产生太大影响，但他指出，如果金正恩对三方峰会的评价积极，他可能会考虑未来与特朗普会面。KEI的金表示，峰会至多有助于打通华盛顿与平壤之间的外交渠道，但不太可能直接促成特朗普与朝鲜领导人恢复接触。她说：“习近平和普京可以向金正恩转达特朗普的信息。不过，他们可能不愿支持美朝谈判，因为他们担心会失去对朝鲜的影响力。”美国前朝鲜国家情报官员悉尼·塞勒认为，习近平和普京可以鼓励特朗普继续向平壤伸出手，并考虑提供激励措施，包括可能放松制裁，而无需承担直接斡旋的角色。塞勒在提及朝鲜官方名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”时说：“习近平或普京都不太可能有意在促成美朝峰会方面扮演更积极的斡旋角色。”这些专家普遍否定将即将举行的峰会与1945年雅尔塔会议相提并论。在那次会议上，美国、英国和苏联讨论了战后国际秩序，而没有其他受其决定直接影响的国家参与。美国前驻韩国代办罗伯特·拉普森称，此类比较具有误导性，并表示三国之间的重大分歧将使达成有意义的协议十分困难。拉普森说：“与雅尔塔会议不同，这次会议并不是在决定世界秩序。它在很大程度上具有象征和表演性质，尽管并非毫无后果。”尽管预计实质成果有限，拉普森仍警告，美国的盟友和伙伴，包括韩国，应密切关注相关讨论，以确保自身安全利益不受损害。拉普森说：“至于包括首尔在内的盟友和伙伴，他们在某种程度上被冷落了，只能尽可能依靠特朗普的高级幕僚，让他们及时了解事态进展，并帮助确保总统不会在他们的核心利益方面偏离轨道。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The foreign ministry said Monday that it has been seeking to reconstruct its aging embassy building in Washington in a project estimated to cost 264.6 billion won ($198 million), but its funding request has not yet been included in next year's government budget proposal.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 外交部周一表示，政府一直寻求重建其位于华盛顿的老旧使馆大楼，该项目预计耗资2646亿韩元（1.98亿美元），但相关资金申请尚未纳入明年的政府预算提案。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The foreign ministry said Monday that it has been seeking to reconstruct its aging embassy building in Washington in a project estimated to cost 264.6 billion won ($198 million), but its funding request has not yet been included in next year's government budget proposal. The ministry made the request to rebuild the building, which was erected in 1954, in 2023, last year and this year due to safety issues, limits to performing diplomatic activities in the aging facilities and concerns about the impact on the national image, it said. The budget subcommittee of the National Assembly's finance, economy, planning and budget committee did not discuss the embassy reconstruction issue in a recent budget deliberation session, an official at the legislature's foreign affairs committee said, a sign that the project could again fail to move forward this year. Major reconstruction projects for overseas diplomatic missions are funded through the finance ministry's state property management fund rather than the foreign ministry's general account budget. Thus the reconstruction issue falls under the jurisdiction of the Assembly's finance committee. In 1990, Korea bought the current embassy building from another country that used it as its military attache's office

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Korea's space industry seeks to turn its growing technological capabilities into international business opportunities as government officials and industry representatives from 18 countries gather in Seoul for a forum focused on commercial space cooperation. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Korea AeroSpace Administration jointly hosted the second Global New Space Forum at the Four Seasons Hotel Seoul on Monday, bringing together representatives of about 40 Korean companies and government officials from 18 countries and international organizations. The gathering aims to connect Korean space companies with overseas agencies and identify opportunities for joint research, technology demonstrations and commercial partnerships. The forum follows the successful fifth launch of Korea's Nuri rocket in October and builds on diplomatic efforts to expand the country's international space network, the organizers said. Kim Jin-a, second vice foreign minister, said in a video address that the growing role of private companies in space exploration had created new diplomatic challenges involving technology cooperation, market access, safety and sustainability. She highlighted three priorities for space diplomacy: creating practical cooperation opportunities between governments and businesses, contributing to the development of international space rules and helping Korean companies enter overseas markets through diplomatic missions and global networks. Kwon Hyun-joon, deputy administrator of the Korea AeroSpace Administration, said the private-sector-led space era had made space a new arena for international cooperation. He called for strengthening Korea's position as a responsible partner in the global space community, accelerating international space exploration projects and building commercial space supply chains with trusted partners. Ibrahim Al Qasim, deputy director-general of the United Arab Emirates Space Agency, delivered the keynote address on the role of governments in encouraging private sector innovation and international cooperation. Two panel discussions examined how geopolitical changes are affecting space partnerships and what policies are needed to expand commercial cooperation. More than 70 one-on-one business-to-government meetings were arranged between Korean companies and overseas officials, offering opportunities to discuss specific projects. The organizers said they would continue supporting Korean companies through overseas business delegations, including planned visits to Mexico and Brazil in December. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism will host a forum Tuesday on how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used in culture, sports and tourism and on how these sectors should shift to AI. The ministry said Monday the fourth Culture, Sports and Tourism Digital Innovation Forum, themed “New Culture Through AI,” will be held at L Tower in Seoul’s Seocho District. About 400 people from government, public institutions and the private sector are expected to attend. State-affiliated bodies are co-organizing the event, including the Korea Culture Information Service Agency, Arts Council Korea, the Korea Sports Promotion Foundation, the Korea Tourism Organization and the Korea Creative Content Agency. The forum will open with an awards ceremony for 15 winners of an AI and cultural data contest. They were chosen in five categories across three fields: new technology, cultural data use and data analysis. Five winners will receive the culture minister’s award. Winning entries include an AI service that lets users talk with historical figures based on historical records and an AI service that rearranges music for people with cochlear implants. Another is a customized AI service for children based on traditional folk tales. A Sungkyunkwan University professor will give the keynote speech on how to live in a world being reshaped by AI. Four breakout sessions will follow on AI in culture and sports, the arts, tourism and content. Topics include responsible use of AI in artistic creation, robots and real-time translation in tourism and AI strategies for visual effects and gaming. At booths in the venue, visitors can try generative AI photo services, AI-based body shape analysis with personalized workout recommendations and real-time interpretation. “The ministry will continue to expand the use of cultural data and support the AI transition in the field to spread digital innovation that people can feel,” a ministry official said. The company said the approach is intended to give Korean employees convenient access to familiar meals while introducing American workers to the cuisine amid growing local interest in Korean food culture. Pulmuone Food & Culture plans to use the Arizona operation as a base for expanding into facilities run by other Korean companies in North America. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: NNPC’s ₦210 trillion question: Not missing is not the same as accounted for, By Posi Olatubosun
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 委员会审查了尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表，发现约₦103万亿被记作应计费用，约₦107万亿被记作其他应收款。尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官向委员会表示，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此为证，说明不可能有₦210万亿不翼而飞。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: The facts are not in dispute. Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. The accrued expenses, according to lawmakers, covered items such as retention fees, legal fees and audit fees without specific breakdowns, and NNPC linked part of them to joint venture cash calls. The committee rejected that explanation, noting that the cash call regime had been abolished with effect from January 2017. The receivables, NNPC said, were owed by defunct banks and other entities, yet no debtors or amounts were named. At about $117 billion, the receivables alone are larger than the economy of many African countries. To understand why both sides can claim to be right, we must be clear about what these accounting terms mean, and this is where the public debate has gone astray. Accrued expenses are liabilities: costs the company says it has incurred but not yet paid. Receivables are assets: amounts the company says others owe it. Neither represents cash that has left the company. In that narrow sense, the former officials are correct that ₦210 trillion has not “disappeared”. But the narrow sense is the wrong test. The real test in accounting is whether a balance is supported by evidence. A liability nobody can itemise and an asset nobody can identify are not bookkeeping details; they are red flags. Consider the scale. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing. Yet the same figure raises a harder question. How can a company accrue unpaid expenses of ₦103 trillion, almost twice its total revenue over seven years? How can it claim receivables of ₦107 trillion from debtors it will not name? Either these balances include large items that are not what their labels suggest, or they reflect unreconciled entries that have accumulated, possibly on both sides of the balance sheet, over many years. Neither explanation inspires confidence. The first concern, therefore, is the quality of the accounts. Under the International Financial Reporting Standards that NNPC applies, receivables must be assessed for recoverability. A debt owed by a bank that no longer exists is, by definition, unlikely to be collected, and should be impaired. If ₦107 trillion of receivables cannot be traced to identifiable debtors, the asset side of NNPC’s balance sheet may be materially overstated. Equally, accrued liabilities must be supported by obligations the company can identify and measure. Unsupported accruals are not prudence; they are a failure of control. The second concern is the role of the external auditors. The committee chairman put the question bluntly: if reconciliation was not done, why did the auditors sign off on the financial statements? International Standards on Auditing require auditors to obtain sufficient, appropriate evidence for material balances, including confirmations for significant receivables and support for accounting estimates. Where they cannot, they are expected to modify their opinion. In July, the committee gave NNPC’s auditors one week to provide a complete schedule of every component of the receivables and payables, and rejected their claims of confidentiality. Auditors are paid to stand behind the figures they certify. Nigerians are entitled to know what evidence supported these balances and what opinion was given. The third concern is governance. The dispute has dragged on for months, with written explanations rejected, summonses ignored and, in June, a warrant of arrest issued against Mr Kyari after he failed to appear. Whatever the merits of each side’s arguments, a public company that cannot produce a schedule of its own receivables after months of parliamentary scrutiny has a governance problem. The committee has raised other queries too, including about ₦5 trillion charged as direct production costs between 2017 and 2021 and an alleged ₦3.8 trillion duplication of subsidy deductions. Each deserves a documented answer, not a press statement. The fourth concern is the market. NNPC has signalled its intention to list on the stock exchange. After the success of the Dangote refinery offer, Nigerians have shown real appetite for owning shares in national energy assets. But no serious investor will buy into a company whose balance sheet contains ₦210 trillion of unexplained entries. Credible accounts are not a favour to the Senate; they are the price of access to capital. What should happen now? Four steps are needed, and each addresses a distinct weakness this dispute has exposed. First, NNPC should publish a full reconciliation of both balances, itemised by counterparty, date and nature, with supporting evidence. This is the starting point because every other step depends on it. A reconciliation turns two aggregate numbers into a list of specific claims that can be checked: who owes NNPC money, whom NNPC owes, since when and for what. It would quickly separate genuine obligations, such as amounts due from joint venture partners or government agencies, from legacy entries that no longer have any basis. Publication matters as much as preparation. NNPC manages the nation’s oil wealth on behalf of all Nigerians, so its accountability runs not only to the Senate but to the public. Months of written explanations exchanged behind closed doors have not settled the matter; open disclosure would. Second, an independent forensic audit, by a firm with no prior relationship with NNPC, should verify that reconciliation. A reconciliation prepared by management is only as credible as those who prepare it, and the same institution produced the balances now in question. A statutory audit tests whether financial statements are fairly presented; a forensic audit goes further, tracing transactions to their source documents and establishing whether any loss, error or misconduct occurred. Independence is essential. Firms that audited or advised NNPC during the affected years cannot credibly review their own work. Only an investigator with no stake in the outcome can produce an answer the public will accept. Third, the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria should review the conduct of the audits for the affected years and act where standards were not met. Audit exists to give users of accounts reasonable assurance that material balances are supported by evidence. If auditors certified ₦210 trillion of balances without sufficient evidence, the failure is not only NNPC’s; it is a failure of the assurance system on which investors, lenders and citizens rely. The Council is the regulator charged with overseeing audit quality. Holding auditors to account in a case of this prominence would send a clear signal to the profession and strengthen confidence in every audited account in Nigeria, not just NNPC’s. Fourth, any receivables that cannot be substantiated should be impaired and any unsupported accruals reversed, with the effect on past results disclosed transparently. Financial statements must reflect economic reality. Carrying uncollectable receivables overstates assets and equity, while unsupported accruals distort liabilities and past profits. Both give a misleading picture of the company’s financial health and of what it should be remitting to the Federation Account. Correcting the balances under the relevant standards, including restating prior periods under IAS 8 where the errors are material, would give NNPC a clean starting point. Disclosing the effect openly would show that the company is prepared to confront its past rather than bury it, which is the minimum any future investor will expect. Ultimately, the issue is not whether ₦210 trillion was stolen; it is whether the national oil company’s accounts can be trusted at all. An entity that manages the country’s most valuable resource on behalf of every Nigerian must meet the highest standard of financial reporting, not the lowest. “Bookkeeping issues” on this scale are not a technicality to be explained away. They are a failure of accountability that must be fixed, transparently and in full, before NNPC asks Nigerians to trust it with their savings. Posi Olatubosun is a UK-based academic faculty member in accounting and finance
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司的210万亿奈拉之问：未失踪并不等于已有交代，作者：波西·奥拉图博松
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh:
事实并无争议。审查尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表后，委员会发现约₦103万亿被记为应计费用，约₦107万亿被记为其他应收款。据议员称，这些应计费用包括保留费、律师费和审计费等项目，但没有具体明细；尼日利亚国家石油公司则将其中一部分与合资项目资本催缴款挂钩。委员会驳斥了这一解释，指出资本催缴制度自2017年1月起已经废除。尼日利亚国家石油公司称，这些应收款是已倒闭银行及其他实体所欠，但既未列明债务人，也未列明金额。仅应收款一项就约合1170亿美元，超过许多非洲国家的经济规模。要理解双方为何都能声称自己正确，就必须弄清楚这些会计术语的含义，而公众辩论的偏差恰恰在于此。应计费用是负债，即公司声称已经发生但尚未支付的成本。应收款是资产，即公司声称他人欠付给自己的款项。两者均不代表已经离开公司的现金。从这个狭义角度看，前任官员的说法是正确的，即₦210万亿并没有“消失”。但狭义标准并非正确标准。会计领域的真正标准，是一项余额是否有证据支持。无人能够逐项列明的负债和无人能够确认的资产，并非无关紧要的记账细节，而是危险信号。

Consider the scale. 尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官告诉委员会，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此证明₦210万亿不可能不翼而飞。然而，同一个数字也提出了一个更难回答的问题。一家公司怎么可能计提₦103万亿的未付费用，这几乎相当于其七年总收入的两倍？它又怎么可能声称拥有₦107万亿的应收款，却拒绝透露债务人身份？这些余额要么包含与其标签所示含义不符的大额项目，要么反映了多年来累积、且可能同时出现在资产负债表两侧的未核对分录。两种解释都无法令人信服。

因此，第一项关切是账目的质量。根据尼日利亚国家石油公司采用的《国际财务报告准则》，应收款必须评估可收回性。一家已不复存在的银行所欠债务，按定义就不太可能收回，因此应当计提减值。如果₦107万亿的应收款无法追溯至可识别的债务人，那么尼日利亚国家石油公司资产负债表的资产端可能被严重高估。同样，应计负债必须由公司能够识别和计量的义务提供支持。缺乏依据的应计项目不是审慎，而是控制失效。

第二项关切是外部审计师的作用。委员会主席直截了当地提出问题：如果没有进行核对，审计师为何仍会在财务报表上签字？《国际审计准则》要求审计师为重大余额获取充分、适当的证据，包括对重大应收款实施函证，以及取得会计估计的支持证据。在无法取得这些证据时，审计师应当修改审计意见。7月，委员会要求尼日利亚国家石油公司的审计师在一周内提供应收款和应付款各项组成部分的完整明细表，并驳回了他们以保密为由提出的异议。审计师领取报酬，就应当为自己所认证的数字负责。尼日利亚人民有权知道，这些余额得到了哪些证据支持，以及审计师出具了何种意见。

第三项关切是治理。这场争端已持续数月，书面解释遭到驳回，传票无人理会；6月，Kyari先生因未出庭而被签发逮捕令。无论双方论据的实质如何，一家公众公司在接受议会数月审查后，仍无法提供自身应收款的明细表，就存在治理问题。委员会还提出了其他疑问，包括2017年至2021年计入直接生产成本的₦5万亿，以及据称重复计算补贴扣减的₦3.8万亿。每项疑问都应得到有文件依据的答复，而不是新闻声明。

第四项关切是市场。尼日利亚国家石油公司已表示有意在证券交易所上市。丹格特炼厂发行获得成功后，尼日利亚人民已表现出持有国家能源资产股票的强烈意愿。但任何认真的投资者都不会投资一家资产负债表含有₦210万亿无法解释分录的公司。可信的账目不是参议院的恩惠，而是获得资本的代价。

现在该怎么办？需要采取四个步骤，每一步都针对这场争端暴露出的不同弱点。第一，尼日利亚国家石油公司应公布对两项余额的完整核对结果，并按交易对手、日期和性质逐项列明，同时提供支持证据。这是起点，因为其他每一步都依赖于此。核对会把两个汇总数字转化为可核查的具体债权清单：谁欠尼日利亚国家石油公司钱，尼日利亚国家石油公司欠谁的钱，欠了多久，因何而产生。它能迅速将合资伙伴或政府机构应付的款项等真实义务，与已经毫无依据的历史遗留分录区分开来。公布与编制同样重要。尼日利亚国家石油公司代表全体尼日利亚人民管理国家石油财富，因此它不仅对参议院负责，也对公众负责。数月来在闭门情况下 exchanged 的书面解释未能解决争端；公开披露则可以。

第二，应由一家与尼日利亚国家石油公司此前没有任何关系的公司开展独立法证审计，核验上述核对结果。由管理层编制的核对结果，其可信度取决于编制者，而相关余额正是同一机构形成的。法定审计检验财务报表是否得到公允列报；法证审计则更进一步，将交易追溯至原始凭证，并确定是否发生了损失、差错或不当行为。独立性至关重要。在受影响年度为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供审计或咨询服务的公司，无法令人信服地审查自己的成果。只有对调查结果没有任何利害关系的调查者，才能给出公众接受的答案。

第三，尼日利亚财务报告委员会应审查受影响年度审计工作的执行情况，并在审计标准未得到遵守时采取行动。审计的存在，是为了向账目使用者合理保证重大余额有证据支持。如果审计师在没有充分证据的情况下认证了₦210万亿的余额，失责的就不仅是尼日利亚国家石油公司，也是投资者、贷款人和公民赖以信赖的审计保证体系的失败。委员会是负责监督审计质量的监管机构。在如此引人注目的案件中追究审计师责任，将向审计行业发出明确信号，并增强公众对尼日利亚所有经审计账目的信心，而不只是对尼日利亚国家石油公司账目的信心。

第四，任何无法得到证实的应收款都应计提减值，任何缺乏支持的应计项目都应予冲销，并透明披露其对以往业绩的影响。财务报表必须反映经济现实。结转无法收回的应收款会高估资产和权益，而缺乏支持的应计项目会扭曲负债和以往利润。两者都会对公司财务健康状况及其应向联邦账户上缴的款项作出误导性描绘。依据相关准则更正这些余额，包括在错误金额重大时依据《国际会计准则第8号》重述以前期间，将为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供一个干净的起点。公开披露相关影响，将表明公司愿意面对过去，而不是将其掩盖；这也是未来任何投资者都会提出的最低要求。

归根结底，问题不在于₦210万亿是否遭到盗用，而在于国家石油公司的账目究竟能否信赖。一家代表每一位尼日利亚人民管理国家最宝贵资源的实体，必须达到财务报告的最高标准，而不是最低标准。如此规模的“记账问题”不是可以用技术性理由搪塞过去的细节，而是必须透明、彻底予以修复的失责问题，然后尼日利亚国家石油公司才能要求人民继续信任它管理自己的积蓄。Posi Olatubosun是一名常驻英国的会计与金融学教师。

MANILA, Philippines – Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Monday, November 16, hailed what he called “truly extraordinary” achievements of China and Southeast Asia in the face of global trade restrictions, expressing Beijing’s commitment to free trade at a summit ahead of US President Donald Trump’s arrival. In remarks to leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in Manila, Li said that at a time of growing unilateralism and protectionism and recurring geopolitical conflict, economic relations between China and ASEAN had only strengthened. “The past five years have been truly extraordinary, and the achievements we scored have not come easily,” he said, citing annual trade with the 11-member ASEAN last year of more than $1 trillion and cumulative two-way investment of more than $500 billion. “We remain firmly committed to safeguarding multilateralism and promoting free trade and endeavor to make the pie bigger,” he said. China is ASEAN’s biggest trading partner and a key source of investment, but the biggest economies of the bloc — which has a combined GDP of more than $3.9 trillion – are keen to expand ties with the United States amid trade and diplomatic uncertainty under the Trump administration. Trump is due to arrive in Manila on Tuesday, November 17, towards the end of the summit ahead of his trip to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, where a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin is scheduled. Anti-Trump protests are expected when he arrives in Manila, after four days of demonstrations and the burning of Trump effigies by leftist groups, students, and workers demanding an end to the Middle East war and the scrapping of the US-led Pax Silica initiative. In Manila, Trump will meet ASEAN leaders and attend his first meeting of the Quad group of Indo-Pacific powers — the US, Japan, Australia, and India — the first such gathering in two years. His predecessor Joe Biden saw the Quad as a signature foreign policy achievement and stressed the importance of maintaining it during his six meetings with the group. The Quad is widely considered an attempt to counterbalance China’s influence in the region, including by Beijing, although its members have said the grouping is not directed against any one country. ASEAN held talks on Monday with the leaders of Australia, South Korea and the United Nations, whose Secretary-General Antonio Guterres reiterated calls for a ceasefire in Ukraine and for greater humanitarian access in war-torn Myanmar. Referring to trilateral talks planned in Shenzhen on Thursday, Guterres also said the UN was ready to fully engage on any denuclearization initiative between the United States, Russia and China, despite a lack of certainty about such an outcome. Trump has previously said he thought a denuclearization deal with Russia and China was possible. China’s Foreign Ministry on Monday said the trilateral talks would “promote world peace and stability”. “This is what we would like to see,” Guterres said about denuclearization. “It’s not yet guaranteed that we will get there.” South Korean President Lee Jae-myung on Monday proposed new initiatives on AI and creative industries to ASEAN and said negotiations to expand their free trade deal were progressing. “We must respond proactively to the changing global trade environment and move forward together towards an era of $300 billion in annual trade,” he said. The ASEAN leaders’ summit ended on Sunday without completing a protracted code of conduct with Beijing to try to manage disputes over the South China Sea, which ASEAN chair the Philippines had hoped could be wrapped up this year. ASEAN also resolved to continue its policy of excluding Myanmar’s leaders from its summits, but left the door open for a return if “sustained and concrete progress” on a peace plan agreed long ago with ASEAN can be demonstrated. The meeting also saw an apology from Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto to neighbouring Singapore and Malaysia over the impact of sustained transboundary haze from months of wildfires. – Rappler.com Loading Related Topics Discover more through topics that were hand-picked by our editors in relation to this article. https://www.rappler.com/philippines/chin.title_zh: 在Trump访问前，中国总理赞扬与东盟的“非凡”关系
https://www.rappler.com/philippines/chin.body_zh: 你于2026年11月16日晚上6:10（PHT）关注了此话题 路透社 你关注了这位作者 收听本文 升级即可收听 由Speechify提供支持 已经拥有Rappler+？登录以收听开创性新闻报道。 中国领导人在东盟峰会上。 在马尼拉举行的第29届东盟—中国峰会暨东南亚国家联盟（东盟）第49届峰会期间，中国总理李强向菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 示意，越南总理黎明兴和新加坡总理黄循财在一旁观看拍照环节。 中国总理李强赞扬中国与东盟之间牢固的经济联系，强调尽管全球贸易面临挑战，双方贸易额仍超过1万亿美元，投资额达到5000亿美元。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普准备抵达马尼拉之际，预计将有人抗议其政府的政策；与此同时，东盟领导人讨论区域合作以及推动无核化的工作。 本文由人工智能生成。 阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 马尼拉，菲律宾——中国总理李强于11月16日星期一赞扬了他所称中国与东南亚“真正非凡”的成就，表示尽管全球贸易限制不断增多，北京仍承诺推动自由贸易。 东盟峰会在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达前举行。李强在马尼拉向东盟各国领导人发表讲话说，在单边主义和保护主义日益抬头、地缘政治冲突反复出现的情况下，中国与东盟之间的经济关系只会更加紧密。 “过去五年真正非同寻常，我们取得的成就来之不易，”他说。去年，他所在的11成员国东盟与中国的年贸易额超过1万亿美元，双向累计投资额超过5000亿美元。 “我们仍坚定致力于维护多边主义并促进自由贸易，努力把蛋糕做大，”他说。 中国是东盟最大的贸易伙伴和重要投资来源，但特朗普政府治下贸易与外交形势不确定，这个集团中最大的经济体都希望扩大与美国的关系。 特朗普预计于11月17日星期二抵达马尼拉，在峰会接近尾声时启程前往深圳参加亚太经济合作论坛；他将在那里参加与中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行的三方会议。 左翼团体、学生和工人持续进行了四天示威，并焚烧特朗普塑像，要求结束中东战争以及废弃美国主导的“Pax Silica”倡议，预计特朗普抵达马尼拉时将发生反特朗普抗议。 在马尼拉，特朗普将会见东盟领导人，并出席 Indo-Pacific 四大国集团——美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度——的首次会议，这是两年来该集团首次举行此类集会。 他的前任乔·拜登将四方安全对话视为其标志性外交政策成果，并强调在六次集团会议中维持这一机制的重要性。 外界普遍认为，四方安全对话是制衡中国在地区影响力的努力，包括对北京施加影响，不过其成员表示，该集团并非针对任何单一国家。 东盟星期一与澳大利亚、韩国和联合国的领导人举行会谈。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯再次呼吁在乌克兰实现停火，并呼吁加强对战火破坏的缅甸的人道主义准入。 古特雷斯谈及计划于星期四在深圳举行的三方会谈时还说，尽管结果尚不确定，联合国仍准备全面参与美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的任何无核化倡议。 特朗普此前曾表示，他认为俄罗斯与中国达成无核化协议是可能的。 中国外交部星期一表示，三方会谈将“促进世界和平与稳定”。 谈及无核化，古特雷斯说：“这正是我们希望看到的。但目前还不能保证我们能够实现这一目标。” 韩国总统李在明星期一向东盟提出有关人工智能和创意产业的新倡议，并称扩大双方自由贸易协定的谈判正在取得进展。 “我们必须主动应对不断变化的全球贸易环境，共同迈向年贸易额3000亿美元的时代，”他说。 东盟领导人峰会于星期日结束，未能与北京完成旨在管控南海争端争议的长期行为准则。 担任东盟轮值主席国的菲律宾原本希望今年能够完成该准则。 东盟还决定继续将缅甸领导人排除在峰会之外，但表示，如果能够证明在东盟多年前达成一致的和平计划上取得“持续和具体进展”，仍为其重返峰会保留空间。 会议期间，印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比anto还就持续数月的野火造成的跨境烟霾影响，向邻近的新加坡和马来西亚道歉。 ——Rappler.com 加载 相关话题 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。以上选择由人工智能生成。阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。升级至Rappler+，获取独家内容和无限访问权限。

https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. should prioritize trade, investment, and regional economic integration at the 33rd Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China, moving beyond geopolitical issues to advance the Philippines’ interests. China is the world’s second-largest economy by nominal gross domestic product (GDP) and the largest by purchasing power parity. Hosting the Apec meeting will help set the tone for how member economies pursue economic growth and cooperation. READ: Marcos to CEOs at Apec Summit: ‘PH open, ready, and eager’ After concluding the Philippines’ hosting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summits and Related Summits on Nov. 17 in Manila, Marcos will fly to China’s “Silicon Valley,” Shenzhen, on Nov. 18 to represent the nation at the economy-centered meeting. Apec serves as a regional economic forum that leverages the growing interdependence of the Asia-Pacific. It aims to ensure that goods, services, investment, and people move easily across borders. In November 1989, the Philippines and 11 other founding countries—Australia, Brunei Darussalam, Canada, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, New Zealand, Singapore, Thailand, and the United States—established it in Canberra, Australia. Hong Kong, China, and Chinese Taipei joined in 1991, followed by Mexico and Papua New Guinea in 1993, and Chile in 1994. Four years later, Peru, Russia, and Viet Nam joined as well, bringing the full membership to 21. This year marks China’s third time hosting the meeting, following Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014. Apec chose Shenzhen, a major technology and manufacturing hub in South China, as its host city. What started as a humble fishing village has transformed into an economic and technology center. Now, it will showcase China’s economic modernization, technological prowess, and reform and opening-up policy. Under the theme “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together,” China set the core priorities: open trade, digital economy and AI growth, and regional connectivity and inclusion. At the 37th Apec Ministerial Meeting in Beijing, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said China is ready to collaborate with member economies to build a progressive Asia-Pacific community. READ: China, ASEAN make progress on SCS pact but can’t finish talks this year The 21 Apec member economies account for around 61 to 62 percent of the global gross domestic product. In this context, Wang called on members to uphold the multilateral trading system under the World Trade Organization. He also underscored the importance of collective efforts to build an innovation ecosystem, accelerate digital and intelligent transformation, and open up new areas for cooperation. For his part, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao said member economies should pursue the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific and eliminate trade and investment obstacles. Additionally, he said member economies should explore a trust-based partnership in the digital and AI economies. China, along with the United States, is a leading country in AI, and its roadmap for the years ahead will be a main topic at the leaders’ meeting. Various meetings have already occurred ahead of the leaders’ meeting on November 18 to 19. These include the 2026 APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the 12th Apec Transport Ministers’ Meeting in Beijing. The 4th Apec Business Advisory Council Meeting runs from November 14 to 16, followed by the Apec Ministerial Meeting on November 16 and 17 and the APEC CEO Summit on November 17 and 18. READ: AFP to VP: Defending PH rights isn’t ‘picking a fight with China’ Like Marcos, US President Donald Trump will head to Shenzhen after the 49th Asean Summit for potential bilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Similarly, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung will also reportedly attend the event. While details of Marcos’ agenda on the sidelines of the Apec Leaders’ Meeting have yet to be provided, the public is watching for the possibility of bilateral meetings with Xi and Trump, although these remain long shots. To recall, Marcos met with the host country’s leader, Lee, during the 32nd Apec meeting in Gyeongju, South Korea, in 2025. Also, Marcos will likely use the economy-focused Apec CEO Summit to woo investors to the Philippines amid global turbulence. Member economies will release an Apec Leaders’ Declaration, a document that outlines their collective agreements, commitments, and strategic goals. They will also announce their commitments on regional trade and investment while updating the public on the agreements reached regarding AI and digital trade. Meanwhile, the public eagerly anticipates hearing about the concerns Filipino businesses raise regarding regional economic integration and whether Marcos will address maritime issues during his meetings. /pai
https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.title_zh: 马科斯在中国举行的亚太经合组织峰会上面临平衡各方关系 challenge
https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body_zh: 马尼拉，菲律宾——菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 应在中国举行的第33届亚太经合组织经济领导人会议上优先推动贸易、投资和区域经济一体化，超越地缘政治问题，以促进菲律宾利益。中国按名义国内生产总值计算是世界第二大经济体，按购买力平价计算则位居第一。主办此次亚太经合组织会议将有助于为各成员经济体追求经济增长与合作确立方向。阅读：马科斯在亚太经合组织峰会上对首席执行官们表示：“菲律宾开放、准备就绪，充满期待”。菲律宾于11月17日在马尼拉结束东南亚国家联盟峰会及相关峰会的承办工作后，马科斯将于11月18日飞往中国“硅谷”深圳，代表国家出席这场以经济为中心的会议。亚太经合组织是一个区域经济论坛，利用亚太地区日益增强的相互依存关系。其目标是确保货物、服务、投资和人员跨境自由流动。1989年11月，菲律宾与另外11个创始国——澳大利亚、文莱达鲁萨兰、加拿大、印度尼西亚、日本、韩国、马来西亚、新西兰、新加坡、泰国和美国——在澳大利亚堪培拉共同创立了该组织。1991年，中国香港和中华台北加入，随后墨西哥和巴布亚新几内亚于1993年加入，智利于1994年加入。四年后，秘鲁、俄罗斯和越南也加入，使正式成员数量增至21个。今年是中国第三次主办该会议，此前曾于2001年和2014年分别在上海和北京举行。亚太经合组织选择中国南方重要的技术和制造业中心深圳作为主办城市。这个曾经不起眼的渔村如今已转型为经济和科技中心。现在，深圳将展示中国的经济现代化、技术实力以及改革开放政策。中国以“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”为主题，确定了核心优先事项：推进贸易开放、数字经济和人工智能增长，以及加强区域互联互通与包容。在北京举行的第37届亚太经合组织部长级会议上，中国外交部长王毅表示，中国愿与各成员经济体合作，建设开放进步的亚太共同体。阅读：中国与东盟在南海行为准则问题上取得进展，但今年无法完成谈判。亚太经合组织21个成员经济体约占全球国内生产总值的61%至62%。在此背景下，王毅呼吁成员维护世界贸易组织框架下的多边贸易体系。他还强调，要通过集体努力建设创新生态系统、加快数字化和智能化转型，并开辟新的合作领域。商务部长王文涛则表示，各成员经济体应推进亚太自由贸易区建设，消除贸易和投资障碍。他还表示，各成员经济体应探索建立数字经济和人工智能经济中的互信伙伴关系。中国与美国是人工智能领域的领先国家，未来数年的发展路线图将是领导人会议的主要议题之一。在11月18日至19日的领导人会议之前，各场会议已陆续举行，其中包括在香港特别行政区举行的2026年亚太经合组织财长会议，以及在北京举行的第12届亚太经合组织交通部长会议。第4届亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会会议于11月14日至16日举行，随后是11月16日至17日的亚太经合组织部长级会议，以及11月17日至18日的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会。阅读：法新社致菲律宾副总统：捍卫菲律宾权利并非“与中国发生冲突”。与马科斯一样，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将在第49届东盟峰会后前往深圳，可能与中国国家主席习近平举行双边会谈。据报道，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、日本首相高市早苗和韩国总统李在明也将出席该活动。尽管亚太经合组织领导人会议边会活动的安排尚未公布，但公众仍在关注马科斯是否可能与习近平和特朗普举行双边会谈，尽管这种可能性仍然不大。回顾一下，2025年亚太经合组织会议在韩国庆州举行时，马科斯曾与东道国领导人李在明会面。此外，在全球经济动荡之际，马科斯很可能利用以经济为重点的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会吸引投资者赴菲律宾。各成员经济体将发布《亚太经合组织领导人宣言》，概述各方共同达成的协议、承诺和战略目标。各方还将宣布在区域贸易和投资方面的承诺，并就人工智能和数字贸易达成的协议向公众通报。与此同时，公众也热切期待了解菲律宾企业对区域经济一体化的关切，以及马科斯是否会在会议期间处理海上问题。 /pai

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: The unification ministry said Monday it is closely watching a senior North Korean official's trip to Moscow, which comes just days before a planned summit of the leaders of the United States, China and Russia. Jo Yong-won, a secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), has been visiting Moscow since Saturday as the head of a party and government delegation, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). He is known as a close aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. The KCNA said the visit comes as the "militant friendship" and "relations of alliance" between Pyongyang and Moscow grow stronger "with each passing day." The purpose and schedule of the trip have not been disclosed. "It is a high-level exchange between North Korea and Russia right before this week's planned summit," ministry spokesperson Yoon Min-ho said at a regular briefing Monday. "We will watch closely what Jo's role would be as head of both a party and a government delegation," he said, drawing a contrast with Kim Song-nam, a member of the WPK's Political Bureau and party secretary, who traveled to China earlier this month on a party-to-party visit. Jo's trip comes days before U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are due to meet on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. It is the latest in a run of high-level overtures from Pyongyang to China and Russia. It has fueled speculation that the North is seeking to build diplomatic leverage ahead of any talks with Washington

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 朝鲜统一部周一表示，正密切关注朝鲜劳动党中央委员会秘书赵容元（Jo Yong-won）访问莫斯科的行程；此次访问发生在美国总统、中国和俄罗斯领导人计划举行峰会前几天。据朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道，统治朝鲜的劳动党（WPK）中央委员会秘书赵容元自周六起以党和政府代表团团长的身份访问莫斯科。他是朝鲜领导人金正恩的亲密助手。朝鲜中央通讯社称，平壤与莫斯科之间的“战斗友谊”和“联盟关系”正“日益加强”，此次访问正是在这一背景下进行的。此次访问的目的和日程尚未公布。统一部发言人尹民浩周一在例行记者会上说：“这是本周计划举行的峰会前夕，朝鲜与俄罗斯之间的一次高层交流。”他说：“我们会密切关注赵容元以党和政府代表团双重身份出访所发挥的作用。”他同时将此次访问与劳动党政治局委员、党中央秘书金松南早些时候本月对中国的党际访问作比较。赵容元的行程安排在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京计划于周四在中国深圳出席亚太经济合作组织峰会期间会晤前几天。这是平壤近期一系列对华和对俄高层接触活动中的最新一次。它引发了外界猜测：朝鲜可能正寻求在与华盛顿举行任何会谈之前积累外交筹码

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: HD现代是韩国一家涵盖造船、重型机械和能源业务的大型企业集团。本周，该集团将在北美最大的清洁能源展览会上展示其最新光伏发电、储能和电网技术，同时寻求扩大自身在快速增长的美国能源市场中的影响力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions and HD Hyundai Electric will jointly participate in RE+ 2026, which runs from Tuesday through Thursday at Las Vegas Convention Center, company officials said Monday. The two affiliates will present technologies spanning solar power generation, energy storage and conversion, and electricity transmission and distribution, highlighting their integrated capabilities across energy infrastructure. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions will unveil its G12R TOPCon Multi-Cut solar module in North America for first time, featuring technology that divides large-area solar cells into smaller sections to reduce power losses during current transmission. The technology enables module efficiency of 24.4 percent by increasing power density, with company planning to gradually introduce advanced Multi-Cut technology across its production lines. HD Hyundai Electric will showcase battery energy storage systems (BESS) and technologies designed to stabilize power grids, including its 96-megawatt Anjwa Island project in Korea’s Sinan County and 100-megawatt Rutile project in Texas. It will also introduce grid-forming technology, which actively controls grid voltage and frequency to improve electricity supply stability, alongside power equipment targeting North American electricity networks and data centers. “Technical capabilities of products, as well as stable supply capacity and project execution capabilities, are emerging as key competitive factors in North American market,” an HD Hyundai official said. “Through this exhibition, we will expand cooperation with local customers and partners and identify tangible business opportunities,” the official said. HD Hyundai Electric is expanding its North American manufacturing operations and BESS business through its Texas subsidiary, while HD Hyundai Energy Solutions is leveraging its integrated domestic solar cell and module production system to address changing U.S. supply chain regulations, including foreign entity of concern requirements. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: LS Electric said Monday it has won a $93.83 million (130 billion won) order to supply power distribution equipment for a hyperscale artificial intelligence (AI) data center. The center is being built by a U.S. Big Tech company, and the order adds to LS Electric’s run of contracts in North America. Under the deal, the Korean power equipment maker will deliver 38-kilovolt high-voltage switchgear and low-voltage switchgear in stages. Switchgear takes in electricity, distributes it among circuits and cuts off faulty lines, which makes it a core part of a data center’s power network. Hyperscale data centers are very large facilities that technology companies run to handle cloud and AI workloads. The company did not name the client. It said it has supplied high-voltage switchgear to the customer’s project from its first phase through the current expansion. LS Electric said “time to power,” the time it takes for a data center to secure electricity and start operating, has become a key competitive factor as AI grows rapidly. It credited the repeat orders to its product quality and its ability to meet tight delivery schedules. The company pointed to its production network: a smart factory in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, LS Electric Utah and the Bastrop Campus in Texas. LS Electric also aims to grow beyond the alternating current systems that dominate the market and into direct current distribution, which it sees as a next-generation technology. It runs a factory in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, which it says is the world’s first manufacturing plant to operate commercially on direct current power. The site tests solid-state transformers, solid-state circuit breakers and energy storage systems for future grids and data centers. “This order once again recognizes the quality of our power equipment and our project capabilities in the North American market,” a company official said, noting that LS Electric recently signed a long-term supply deal with another Big Tech firm. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: LS Electric赢得9400万美元订单，为美国人工智能数据中心供应电力设备

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: It was released to the public on Monday. HT was given early access to a copy of the report. According to the report, titled Open Doors Report on International Educational Exchange, the latest decline was driven largely by a 34% drop in Indian students pursuing graduate programmes, whose numbers fell from 177,892 in 2024–25 to 116,609. Undergraduate enrolments also dipped marginally to 39,711 from 40,135. However, the number of Indian students participating in OPT, which allows international graduates to gain work experience in the US after completing their degrees, rose 27% to 182,201. Across all academic levels, 57% of international students were enrolled in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) fields. Mathematics and computer science, with 286,168 students, and engineering, with 214,193, were the most popular fields. Meanwhile, OPT participation among international students rose 14% to 335,785. The number of new international students — those enrolling at a US institution for the first time — fell 18% to 228,123. The report’s fall 2026 snapshot, based on responses from more than 800 US higher education institutions, points to a further slowdown. Overall international student numbers declined 9%, with new enrolments falling 15%. Graduate enrolments dropped 15%, undergraduate numbers 3% and OPT participation 6%. The decline comes amid tightening US immigration measures and visa-related uncertainties. HT reported on October 23 that arrivals of Indian students in the US on F and M category visas had plunged 39% year-on-year to 25,321 in August 2026. Experts and study-abroad consultants cited stricter visa screening, delays in appointments and processing, higher rejection rates and uncertainty over post-study employment opportunities, including OPT, as factors affecting student mobility
