https://www.myjoyonline.com/abibinsroma-.body: Foundation says the decision is an important step towards climate action, affordable renewable energy and a Just Transition for all Ghanaians. AbibiNsroma Foundation welcomes and congratulates the Government of Ghana on its decision, announced in the 2027 Budget Statement, to remove import duties and Value Added Tax (VAT) on solar panels and batteries. We consider this an important step towards making renewable energy more affordable and accessible to Ghanaians, while demonstrating the country’s commitment to promoting clean energy and addressing the growing impacts of climate change. For us at AbibiNsroma Foundation, this announcement goes beyond tax exemptions. It is an opportunity to accelerate Ghana’s transition to renewable energy, reduce dependence on fossil fuels and make clean energy a realistic option for more households, businesses and communities. Ghana, like many other African countries, continues to experience the effects of climate change, including flooding, rising temperatures, coastal erosion and other environmental challenges. We believe that investing in renewable energy is part of the practical action needed to address these challenges and build a more sustainable future. We are particularly encouraged by the potential of this decision to create opportunities for households, small businesses, farmers, women and young people who often face financial barriers to accessing clean energy. As a Foundation, we believe that the energy transition must be fair, inclusive and beneficial to everyone, not just those who can afford it. Expanding access to solar energy and battery storage can contribute significantly to Ghana’s climate ambitions. It can help reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve energy security, support local businesses and create new opportunities in the growing green economy. We also see this decision as an opportunity for Ghana to strengthen its contribution to the goals of the Paris Agreement and demonstrate leadership in Africa’s transition towards cleaner and more sustainable energy systems. However, the success of this policy should not be measured only by the number of solar panels imported into the country. It should also be measured by how many ordinary Ghanaians, particularly those in underserved communities, can actually afford and benefit from solar energy. At AbibiNsroma Foundation, we strongly believe that climate action must put people and communities at the centre of decision-making. Women, young people, low-income households, rural communities, coastal populations and small-scale businesses must not be left behind in Ghana’s transition to renewable energy. We therefore encourage the Government to build on this announcement by introducing additional measures that will make the benefits of this policy reach ordinary people. 1. Make solar energy affordable: Promote accessible financing and credit facilities to help households and small businesses acquire solar systems. 2. Support women and young people: Create opportunities for women-led businesses and youth entrepreneurs in the renewable energy sector. 3. Invest in green jobs: Strengthen technical training and skills development in solar installation, maintenance and battery management. 4. Promote local industries: Encourage local assembly, manufacturing, innovation and investment in renewable energy technologies. 5. Reach vulnerable communities: Give particular attention to rural, coastal and underserved communities that face energy access challenges. 6. Protect the environment: Strengthen battery recycling, electronic waste management and responsible disposal systems to prevent future environmental pollution. While welcoming this announcement, we encourage the Government to ensure that the tax exemptions are implemented effectively in 2027 and that the savings are reflected in the prices paid by consumers. We also call on government agencies, civil society organisations, development partners, the private sector and community organisations to work together to ensure that this policy delivers real benefits for the people of Ghana. We believe Ghana has an opportunity to make renewable energy a major driver of sustainable development, climate resilience, job creation and economic transformation. Our message is simple: climate action must not only be about protecting the environment; it must also improve people’s lives. AbibiNsroma Foundation remains committed to working with government, civil society, development partners and communities to advance climate justice, renewable energy advocacy and a Just Transition in Ghana and across Africa. We congratulate the Government on this policy announcement and look forward to seeing it translated into practical benefits for all Ghanaians. AbibiNsroma Foundation is a Ghana-based organisation committed to environmental sustainability, climate justice, community development and inclusive sustainable development. The Foundation works to promote locally led climate action, strengthen community participation in environmental decision-making and advocate for policies that respond to the needs and priorities of vulnerable communities in Ghana and across Africa
https://www.myjoyonline.com/abibinsroma-.title_zh: Abibinsroma 基金会就2027年预算中的太阳能税收减免向政府表示祝贺
https://www.myjoyonline.com/abibinsroma-.body_zh: AbibiNsroma基金会表示，这项决定是推动气候行动、实现可负担的可再生能源以及为全体加纳人实现公正转型的重要一步。AbibiNsroma基金会对加纳政府在其2027年预算声明中宣布取消太阳能板和电池的进口关税及增值税（VAT）表示欢迎和祝贺。我们认为，这是让加纳人更容易获得并负担得起可再生能源的重要一步，同时也体现了加纳 promotes 清洁能源并应对气候变化日益严重影响的承诺。对AbibiNsroma基金会而言，这一宣布不仅意味着税收优惠。它也是加快加纳向可再生能源转型、减少对化石燃料依赖，并让更多家庭、企业和社区能够现实地选择清洁能源的机会。与许多其他非洲国家一样，加纳持续承受气候变化的影响，包括洪灾、气温上升、海岸侵蚀及其他环境挑战。我们认为，投资可再生能源是应对这些挑战、建设更加可持续未来所需实际行动的一部分。这一决定有望为家庭、小型企业、农民、女性和青年创造机会；这些群体往往在获得清洁能源方面面临资金障碍，令我们尤其受到鼓舞。作为一家基金会，我们认为，能源转型必须公平、包容，并让所有人受益，而不能只惠及负担得起的人。扩大太阳能和电池储能的普及，可以对加纳的气候目标作出重要贡献。它有助于减少温室气体排放、改善能源安全、支持本地企业，并为不断发展的绿色经济创造新机会。我们还认为，这项决定为加纳加强自身对《巴黎协定》目标的贡献，并在非洲向更清洁、更可持续的能源系统转型过程中展现领导力提供了机会。然而，评估这项政策的成效时，不应只看进口到该国的太阳能板数量，还应看有多少普通加纳人，特别是生活在服务不足社区的人，实际上能够负担并受益于太阳能。AbibiNsroma基金会坚信，气候行动必须把人民和社区置于决策核心。在加纳向可再生能源转型的过程中，女性、青年、低收入家庭、农村社区、沿海居民和小规模企业绝不能被落下。因此，我们鼓励政府在此项宣布的基础上推出更多措施，让政策红利惠及普通民众。1. 让太阳能变得可负担：推广易于获得的融资和信贷服务，帮助家庭和小型企业购置太阳能系统。2. 支持女性和青年：为女性主导的企业及可再生能源领域的青年创业者创造机会。3. 投资绿色就业：加强太阳能安装、维护和电池管理方面的技术培训与技能开发。4. 促进本地产业发展：鼓励在可再生能源技术领域推动本地组装、制造、创新和投资。5. 覆盖脆弱社区：特别关注面临能源获取挑战的农村、沿海和服务不足社区。6. 保护环境：加强电池回收、电子废物管理和负责任的处置体系，防止未来发生环境污染。在欢迎这项宣布的同时，我们鼓励政府确保税收优惠在2027年得到有效落实，并将节省的成本反映到消费者支付的价格中。我们还呼吁政府机构、公民社会组织、发展伙伴、私营部门和社区组织携手合作，确保这项政策为加纳人民带来切实利益。我们认为，加纳有机会让可再生能源成为可持续发展、气候韧性、就业创造和经济转型的重要驱动力。我们的诉求很简单：气候行动不仅必须着眼于保护环境，也必须改善人们的生活。AbibiNsroma基金会继续致力于与政府、公民社会、发展伙伴和社区合作，在加纳及整个非洲推动气候正义、可再生能源倡导和公正转型。我们祝贺政府作出这项政策宣布，并期待看到相关措施转化为惠及全体加纳人的实际成果。AbibiNsroma基金会是一家总部位于加纳的组织，致力于环境可持续性、气候正义、社区发展和包容性可持续发展。该基金会致力于推动由本地主导的气候行动，加强社区参与环境决策，并倡导符合加纳及整个非洲脆弱社区需求和优先事项的政策

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription In a significant breakthrough towards the conclusion of the India-U.S. interim deal on trade, the U.S. has assured India of a comparative advantage over its competitors once it finalises its tariff structure, a senior official in the Ministry of Commerce and Industry said, adding that both sides are working to complete the deal by the end of the current financial year. Indian officials have repeatedly been saying that India would move ahead with a deal only if the U.S. assured it of a comparative advantage, as was agreed to in the February 2026 joint statement between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and U.S. President Donald Trump. Separately, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal confirmed that a two-man team from the U.S. visited India earlier this month during which substantial progress was made towards finalising the text of the deal. “Talks between India and the U.S. are ongoing and the U.S. has assured us of a comparative advantage over our competitor countries,” the senior official said on the condition of anonymity as the details of the bilateral discussions have not yet been made public. This is a significant development because Indian officials, including Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal, have repeatedly said that India would move ahead with a deal with the U.S. only if it is assured of a comparative advantage over its competitors. The February joint statement stated that the U.S. and India “commit to provide each other preferential market access in sectors of respective interest on a sustained basis”. However, since then, the U.S. has imposed additional 10% ‘forced labour’ tariffs on India, the same as on some of its competitors such as Indonesia, Malaysia, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. Further, the U.S. is currently conducting another investigation into India and several other countries related to excess capacity, which could see additional tariffs being levied. The official, however, said that the U.S. assurance of comparative advantage for India takes into account this future tariff. “The attempt by both sides is to complete the deal by the end of this financial year,” the official added. “We have also agreed to a clause that says that if either country changes its tariffs on the other country, then the second country can also modify its commitments under the deal. This was also a part of the February joint statement.” The official said that such a clause is “not usual” in trade deals that India enters into, but that it had specifically been included in the deal with the U.S. Separately, Mr. Agrawal said that the talks between the two sides were “on the right track” and that the teams are engaged both in-person and virtually. “There was a small team from the U.S. that visited India for discussions on customs and trade facilitation in the first week of November,” he said. “The discussions went off in a very positive direction. A lot of issues were closed, and there was convergence in a lot of areas.” In addition, he said that the chief negotiators of both sides regularly speak with each other virtually to carry forward the discussions and “iron out some of the language issues or some of the small fixes that remain in the agreement”. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body_zh:

在印度与美国临时贸易协议即将取得重大进展之际，印度工商部一名高级官员表示，美国已向印度保证，待其最终确定关税结构后，印度将相对其竞争对手享有比较优势；双方正努力在本财政年度结束前完成协议。

印度官员多次表示，只有美国保证印度相对其竞争对手享有比较优势，印度才会推进协议。2026年2月，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发表的联合声明中曾就此达成一致。

此外，商务秘书拉杰什·阿格罗沃尔证实，美国派出了一个两人代表团，于本月早些时候访问印度，双方在敲定协议文本方面取得了实质进展。

这名高级官员在匿名条件下表示：“印度与美国之间的谈判仍在进行，美国已向我们保证，相对竞争国家，我们将享有比较优势。”由于双方双边讨论的细节尚未公开，他要求匿名。

这是一项重大进展。印度官员，包括商务部长皮尤什·戈亚尔在内，多次表示，只有美国保证印度相对其竞争对手享有比较优势，印度才会推进与美国的协议。

2月发表的联合声明称，美国和印度“承诺持续在各自关注的相关领域为彼此提供优惠市场准入”。然而，自那以后，美国对印度额外征收了10%的“强迫劳动”关税，对印度尼西亚、马来西亚、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡等一些竞争对手也征收了同样税率的关税。

此外，美国目前正就产能过剩问题对印度及其他几个国家展开另一项调查，未来可能征收额外关税。不过，该官员表示，美国向印度作出的比较优势保证已考虑这项未来可能征收的关税。

该官员补充说：“双方的目標是在本财政年度结束前完成协议。我们还同意加入一项条款：如果其中任何一国调整对另一国的关税，另一国也可以修改其在协议中的承诺。2月的联合声明中也包含了这一内容。”

该官员表示，此类条款在印度参与签订的交易中“并不常见”，但这次却专门纳入了印度与美国的协议。

阿格罗沃尔先生另行表示，双方谈判“方向正确”，各团队正通过线下和线上方式开展磋商。

他说：“11月第一周，美国派出一个小代表团访问印度，讨论海关和贸易便利化事宜。讨论进展非常积极，许多问题得到解决，双方在许多领域达成了共识。”

他还表示，双方首席谈判代表经常通过线上方式交流，以推进讨论，并“解决协议中残留的一些措辞问题或一些小幅修改事项”。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111502.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 권숙희 기자 = 젠슨 황 엔비디아 전 최고경영자(CEO)의 퇴진에는 미국의 중간선거 이후 정쟁의 영향도 있다는 중국 관영매체 주장이 나왔다. 중국 매체들은 대체로 황 전 CEO를 옹호하면서 그가 정치적 희생양일 가능성을 제기하고 있다. 중국 관영 베이징르바오(北京日報)의 소셜미디어 계정인 '창안제즈스'는 14일(현지시간) '젠슨 황의 거취가 우리의 방향을 바꾸지는 못한다'는 제목의 게시물에서 공식적인 증거는 없다면서도 젠슨 황의 퇴진에 불륜 외의 요인이 영향을 미쳤을 것이라고 주장했다. 이 매체는 미국에서 거대 기술기업 최고위 인사들이 혼외 관계를 맺는 일이 적지 않다는 사실을 지적하면서 "이번 파문이 불거진 시점에 주목할 필요가 있다"며 지난 3일 미 중간선거에서 공화당이 참패하고 민주당의 의회 장악이 결정된 시점에서 발생한 일이라는 데 주목했다. 창안제즈스는 "현재 민주당이 젠슨 황의 퇴진을 기획했다는 증거는 없다"라면서도 "다만 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 귀빈이었던 젠슨 황은 이번 당파 싸움의 영향을 받을 수밖에 없었다"고 주장했다. 바이위촨 중국 상하이대외경제무역대학 국제기구학원 강사는 이 매체와의 인터뷰에서 "젠슨 황 스캔들에 대한 조사가 이미 1년 전인 2025년 10월 시작됐으나 공개된 것은 최근이었다"라며 "이는 중간선거의 상황과 매우 밀접한 관련이 있는 것"이라고 말했다. 또한 이 매체는 젠슨 황이 미중 간 인공지능(AI) 경쟁에서 균형을 잡는 매우 특별한 역할을 해왔다는 점을 인정해야 한다며 그를 옹호했다. 창안제즈스는 "젠슨 황의 퇴진은 미국 정·재계에서 국가안보와 경제적 이익 사이의 균형을 적극적으로 주장해온 목소리 하나가 사라졌음을 의미한다"라며 "엔비디아 자체의 전환점일 뿐만 아니라 미국의 대중국 반도체 수출 정책에도 전환점이 될 수 있다"고 내다봤다. 아울러 젠슨 황의 퇴진이 결국 중국의 반도체 자립을 가속하는 계기가 될 수 있다면서 전통 제조업부터 신에너지차에서 이미 비슷한 흐름이 있었다고 짚었다. 앞서 지난 13일 중국 관영 영자지 글로벌타임스도 "오늘은 젠슨황, 다음은? 워싱턴의 표적 명단은 계속 늘어날 수 있다"는 제목으로 비슷한 논평을 실은 바 있다. 이 매체는 "현재 미국의 정치 환경에서는 통상적인 기업 경영 논리마저 '정치적으로 올바르지 않은 것'으로 여겨지고 있다"라며 "미국 기업인들은 글로벌 시장에서의 기술 경쟁은 물론 워싱턴의 정치적 검증과 동시에 싸우도록 강요받고 있다"고 논평했다. 이어 "실리콘밸리의 기업인들은 앞으로 모든 결정을 내릴 때 자신이 어떤 잘못을 저질렀는지를 따지기보다 미중 양국과 관련된 사업상 결정이 언젠가 '국가안보 위험'으로 재규정될 가능성을 걱정해야 할 것"이라고 꼬집었다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/15 11:46 송고 2026년11월15일 11시46분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111502.title_zh: 中国媒体力挺黄仁勋……“美中 intermediary选举后党内纷争将产生影响”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111502.body_zh:
（首尔＝韩联社）权淑姬记者＝中国官媒主张，NVIDIA前首席执行官黄仁勋的离任也受到美国中期选举后政治纷争的影响。中国媒体大多声援黄仁勋，并提出他可能成为政治牺牲品。中国官媒《北京日报》的社交媒体账号“长安街知事”14日（当地时间）发布题为“黄仁勋的去留不会改变我们的方向”的帖子，称尽管没有正式证据，但黄仁勋的离任受到了背信行为以外因素的影响。该媒体指出，美国大型科技企业高管之间结成婚外情的情况并不少见，并表示：“有必要关注这场风波被炒热的时机。”此事发生在过去3日美国中期选举确定共和党惨败、民主党掌控国会之际。

“长安街知事”表示：“目前没有证据显示民主党策划了黄仁勋的离职。”但同时主张：“不过，曾是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普密友的黄仁勋难免受到这场党派斗争的影响。”上海对外经济贸易大学国际组织学院讲师毕伟晨在该媒体接受采访时表示：“针对黄仁勋丑闻的调查早在一年前的2025年10月就已开始，但直到最近才公开。这与中期选举的局势密切相关。”

该媒体还承认，黄仁勋在中美人工智能（AI）竞争中一直发挥着极为特殊、维持平衡的作用，并表示支持他。“长安街知事”称：“黄仁勋的离任意味着，在美国政界和经济界积极主张国家security与经济利益之间平衡的一个声音消失了。”并预测：“这不仅会成为NVIDIA自身的转折点，也可能成为美国对华半导体出口政策的转折点。”

此外，该媒体指出，黄仁勋的离任最终可能成为中国实现半导体自主化的契机，而从传统制造业到新能源汽车，中国早已出现类似的趋势。

此前，中国官媒《环球时报》13日也以“今天是黄仁勋，下一个是谁？华盛顿的标靶名单可能继续增加”为题刊登了类似评论。该媒体评论称：“在当前美国的政治环境下，连常规的企业经营逻辑都可能被视为‘政治上不正确’。”并评论道：“美国企业人士不仅要在全球市场进行技术竞争，还被迫同时接受华盛顿的政治审查。”

该媒体进一步强调：“硅谷的企业人士今后在作出每一项决定时，都不应只盘算自己犯过什么错，而应担心与中美两国相关的商业决定日后可能被重新界定为‘国家安全风险’。”

https://punchng.com/ogun-to-host-tech-su.body: T echnology stakeholders and professionals in the digital ecosystem will converge on Abeokuta, the Ogun State capital, for the seventh edition of the Ogun Digital Summit, where calls for a dedicated Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy are expected to feature prominently. The convener of the summit, Victor Adeleye, in a statement on Saturday, said the event will hold from November 25 to 27, 2026. Adeleye, a technology entrepreneur and ecosystem builder, said a dedicated ministry would provide the institutional framework to harness the state’s technology potential, support start-ups, and attract private sector investment. He noted that the state possessed the advantages to emerge as a major technology destination, citing its concentration of educational institutions, proximity to Lagos, industrial activities, and growing youth population. Adeleye, however, stressed the need for deliberate policies and institutional support to translate these advantages into economic opportunities. Ogun ADC rejects caretaker committee, parallel leadership Abiodun rallies support for N600m Ogun palace project Nigeria needs 700,000 houses annually to tackle 28m deficit – Mortgage bank chair According to him, the proposed ministry would oversee broadband infrastructure, digital skills development, start-up support, technology investment, e-governance, and innovation policies. He added that it would strengthen collaboration between the state government, the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, private investors, and other relevant agencies. Adeleye said the initiative would help attract technology companies, create employment opportunities for young professionals, and provide a supportive environment for local entrepreneurs. He also called for the expansion of digital development beyond Abeokuta to other major towns, including Ijebu-Ode, Sagamu, and Ota. Olufemi Adediran

https://unn.ua/en/news/the-united-states.body: The Pentagon is reviewing the plan to withdraw troops from Europe: instead of 25,000, around 5,000 may be withdrawn. Trump will make the decision. The administration of U.S. President Donald Trump may significantly reduce the scale of the planned withdrawal of American troops from Europe. While NATO allies previously feared a reduction of the contingent by 25,000 troops, they now expect the withdrawal of approximately 5,000. Bloomberg reports this, citing informed sources, writes UNN . According to the publication, the Pentagon is reviewing its plans due to increased defense spending by European allies and the importance of U.S. military bases in Europe for operations in the Middle East. In particular, the war with Iran demonstrated how dependent the United States is on European infrastructure for the deployment of troops and aircraft and for supporting combat operations. We have a lot of resources there that are exactly where we need them. I do not expect anything major According to Bloomberg sources, the main reduction may affect Germany, which hosts the largest U.S. military contingent in Europe. At the same time, NATO's eastern flank is planned to be strengthened. Countries bordering Russia have offered to assume part of the costs of maintaining U.S. troops. The final decision will be made by Donald Trump. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is expected to present the president with relevant recommendations on December 1. For now, the Pentagon continues to assess possible scenarios and their implications for European security. At the same time, U.S. legislation limits the possibilities for reducing the military presence. Congress previously prohibited reducing the U.S. contingent in Europe below 76,000 service members without the necessary consultations with allies and a risk assessment. According to Bloomberg, political changes following the midterm elections to Congress may also complicate the implementation of a large-scale withdrawal of American troops

https://unn.ua/en/news/the-united-states.body_zh: 五角大楼正在重新评估从欧洲撤军的计划：撤军人数可能不是25,000人，而是约5,000人。特朗普将作出决定。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府可能会大幅缩减从欧洲撤走美军人员的规模。此前，北约盟国担心驻军规模将削减25,000人，而如今预计将撤走约5,000人。《彭博社》援引知情人士报道了此事，UNN写道。据该出版物报道，由于欧洲盟国增加了国防开支，以及美国在欧洲的军事基地对中东行动的重要性，五角大楼正在重新审视相关计划。特别是，与伊朗的战争表明，美国在部署部队和飞机以及支援战斗行动方面对欧洲基础设施有多大的依赖。我们在当地拥有大量资源，而这些资源恰好位于我们最需要它们的地方。我不预计会有任何重大变化。据《彭博社》消息人士称，削减规模最大的影响可能涉及德国；德国驻有欧洲规模最大的美军部队。与此同时，北约东翼计划得到加强。与俄罗斯接壤的国家已提出承担维持美军驻留的部分费用。最终决定将由唐纳德·特朗普作出。预计国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯将于12月1日向总统提交相关建议。目前，五角大楼仍在评估各种可能方案及其对欧洲安全的影响。与此同时，美国立法限制了减少军事驻军的可能性。国会此前禁止在未与盟国进行必要磋商和风险评估的情况下，将美国驻欧洲部队规模削减至76,000名现役军人以下。据《彭博社》报道，国会中期选举后的政治变化也可能使大规模撤走美军变得复杂

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/s.body: The former Deputy Minority Whip of the 8th Senate and three-time Senator representing Bayelsa Central, Senator Emmanuel Paulker, has declared his unwavering loyalty to the Peoples Democratic Party PDP). Speaking when he received members of the State Working Committee and other party leaders, led by the state chairman, Hon. Chief Alabh George Turnah, during a courtesy visit at his residence in Yenagoa, he reaffirmed his unbroken loyalty to the PDP and declared that he does not intend to leave the party. Paulker, who represented Bayelsa Central between 2007 and 2019, assured members of the party of his commitment to the resurgence of the party. “Since 1998, I have not left the PDP for even a second. I will not leave this party.” Paulker, while commending Turnah for his courageous and dynamic leadership of the party, assured him of his total commitment and support. He also urged the leadership to remain united, focused, carry all stakeholders along and pursue reconciliation despite internal challenges. “My doors are open to you at all times. Hold firm; the party is in safe hands under your leadership, and I am with you all the way.” Paulker expressed confidence that the PDP would emerge stronger and bounce back to power in the state. He enjoined leaders and members to remain committed to the party’s success, stressing that all the big names in Bayelsa politics started their politics from the PDP. Turnah, in his remarks, described Paulker as a founding pillar of the PDP in Bayelsa, acknowledging his contributions to the party and the state’s political development. He noted that Paulker’s experience, wisdom and guidance have remained a source of inspiration and strength to the current leadership of the Party in the State. Meanwhile, the leadership of the party has resolved to transfer full responsibility for the campaigns of its National Assembly candidates to the candidates themselves. A statement by the party’s publicity secretary, Ikaebimo Mark, stated that the leadership of the party will now concentrate its efforts on the statewide campaign for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu under the National Rainbow Coalition arrangement. Mark, who disclosed that the decision was taken at the regular meeting of the State Working Committee held on Thursday, 12th November 2026, added that it is in accordance with the directive of the party’s national leader, Nyesom Ezenwo Wike, issued in consultation with the National Working Committee of the Peoples Democratic Party. According to Mark, consequently, all National Assembly candidates are directed to take complete charge of their respective campaigns and to intensify community-to-community engagements across the state. He stated that the candidates are advised to proceed independently with their campaigns, as most have already been doing. Mark however noted that the party will, however, remain available to offer guidance and support whenever any National Assembly candidate seeks such assistance. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/s.title_zh: Paulker参议员宣布效忠PDP，该党在巴耶尔萨优先支持蒂努布竞选连任
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/s.body_zh: 第8届参议院前少数党党鞭、三度代表巴耶尔萨中区的参议员伊曼纽尔·保尔克已宣布对人民民主党（PDP）坚定不移的忠诚。在州主席阿巴夫·乔治·图纳阁下的带领下，州工作委员会成员及其他党内领导人于对其位于耶纳戈阿的住所进行礼节性拜访时，他发表讲话，重申自己对人民民主党的忠诚从未中断，并声明无意离开该党。保尔克在2007年至2019年间代表巴耶尔萨中央区，并向党内成员保证，他致力于推动该党东山再起。他说：“自1998年以来，我甚至一秒钟都没有离开过人民民主党。我不会离开这个党。”保尔克赞扬图纳以勇气和充满活力的方式领导该党，并保证将全力承诺和支持他。他还敦促党的领导层保持团结和专注，带动所有利益相关方，并在内部挑战面前推动和解。他说：“我的大门任何时候都向你们敞开。坚定信念；在你们的领导下，这个党掌握在可靠的手中，而我会始终与你们同在。”保尔克相信，人民民主党将变得更加强大，并在该州重掌权力。他告诫领导人和党员继续致力于推动该党成功，强调巴耶尔萨政界的所有大人物都是从人民民主党起步的。图纳在发言中称保尔克是人民民主党在巴耶尔萨的创始支柱之一，acknowledging他对该党和该州政治发展的贡献。他指出，保尔克的经验、智慧和指导始终是党内现任领导层从中汲取灵感和力量的源泉。与此同时，党的领导层决定，将全国议会候选人的竞选活动全部交由候选人 themselves负责。该党宣传秘书伊卡埃比莫·马克在一份声明中表示，党的领导层现在将集中精力开展全州范围的竞选活动，支持总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布在全国彩虹联盟框架下寻求连任。马克透露，这项决定是在2026年11月12日星期四举行的州工作委员会例会上作出的，符合该党全国领袖尼耶索姆·埃泽诺·威克在与人民民主党全国工作委员会磋商后发布的指示。马克表示 consequently，所有全国议会候选人均被要求全面负责各自的竞选活动，并加强在全州各社区之间的联系。他说，建议候选人独立推进各自的竞选活动，因为大多数人已经在这样做。不过，马克指出，如有任何全国议会候选人寻求协助，该党仍愿随时提供指导和支持。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地以及世界各地设有办公室。对于政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层而言，它是通过所有平台获取尼日利亚最权威新闻资讯的媒体，同时充当抱负者和千禧一代的新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交叉地带。您可以发送电子邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: Minister of Innovation, Science and Technology, Dr Kingsley Udeh, on Saturday officially inaugurated a political support group, As Tinubu and Mbah Move (ATM), to mobilise support for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, Enugu State Governor Peter Mbah and other All Progressives Congress (APC) candidates in the 2027 general elections. The group, which is anchored on technology and innovation, is expected to deploy digital tools to mobilise voters, monitor grassroots engagement and track its membership and electoral mobilisation activities across the 4,145 polling units in Enugu State. Speaking at the inauguration, Governor Mbah commended Udeh for the initiative, describing its technological approach and grassroots mobilisation strategy as important complements to the existing political structures of the APC in the state. Mbah, who expressed excitement over the large turnout at the event, urged members of the group to extend the enthusiasm generated by the inauguration to communities, villages, kindreds, families and polling units across the state. He said the support group’s effectiveness would be measured not by the crowd at its inauguration but by its ability to translate the energy into grassroots mobilisation and electoral support. “ATM, this heat, this energy must go beyond this inauguration hall. You must take this energy to our streets, villages, polling units, kindreds and families,” he said. The governor urged members to convince voters through visible development projects and the achievements of his administration, including Smart Green Schools, the International Conference Centre, Presidential Hotel, International Hospital and other infrastructure projects. On President Tinubu’s re-election bid, Mbah described the President as a unifier, arguing that his administration’s economic reforms and infrastructure investments had laid the foundation for national growth and shared prosperity. He said the President’s decision to remove fuel subsidy and unify the foreign exchange regime demonstrated the political courage required to address longstanding structural challenges in the Nigerian economy. According to him, although the reforms initially imposed difficulties on citizens, they were necessary to restore macroeconomic stability, rebuild confidence in the economy and attract private capital and foreign investment. Mbah argued that sustained economic reforms were necessary to translate the emerging growth trajectory into employment opportunities and improved living conditions for Nigerians. He also highlighted the Federal Government’s infrastructure interventions in the South-East, particularly the improved Enugu-Onitsha highway, the ongoing Enugu-Port Harcourt Expressway project and the concessioning of the Akanu Ibiam International Airport. The governor said the airport concession would strengthen the South-East’s economic competitiveness, particularly with the planned commencement of cargo operations and direct flights between Enugu and Guangzhou, China, before the end of the first quarter of 2027. He maintained that the region stood to benefit significantly from the expansion of its aviation and cargo-handling capacity, given the volume of goods currently transported by road from Lagos to the South-East. On the political implications of the 2027 elections, Mbah urged the people of the South-East to adopt a strategic approach to national politics, stressing the importance of building political alliances beyond the region. He recalled the political alignments of the First and Second Republics, particularly the alliances involving Dr Nnamdi Azikiwe and Dr Michael Okpara, as examples of how political cooperation across regional boundaries could advance the interests of the Igbo. The governor argued that supporting Tinubu’s re-election would provide the South-East with an opportunity to strengthen its political relevance and deepen its participation in national governance. He cautioned APC members against complacency, despite the party’s dominance of the state’s political structures, urging them to campaign vigorously as though they were the underdogs. Mbah disclosed that the group would complement the party’s existing structures across the state’s 4,145 polling units, adding that its digital monitoring platform would provide a verifiable picture of grassroots mobilisation. He also urged eligible voters who had yet to collect their Permanent Voter Cards (PVCs) to do so and mobilise for the January 16, 2027, presidential and National Assembly elections, as well as the February 6, 2027, governorship and State Assembly polls. The governor, however, stressed that the administration’s development agenda remained a work in progress, noting that the presence of poverty, inadequate electricity supply, water challenges and unpaved roads in some communities meant that more work was required. Earlier, the convener of ATM, Dr Udeh, said the support group was different from conventional political organisations because of its reliance on technology, innovation and a data-driven approach to electoral mobilisation. He disclosed that the group had established an innovation situation room and digital dashboard to monitor membership registration, grassroots activities and voter mobilisation across polling units. According to him, membership registration would be tied to the possession of a PVC and the submission of voters’ identification details through a dedicated online portal, while the platform would also track referrals and recruitment of new members. Udeh said the initiative was designed to replace unverified membership claims with a credible database that would enable the group to measure its performance and provide verifiable reports. He added that Governor Mbah would have direct access to the dashboard to monitor activities, verify membership figures and assess the group’s progress. Describing the initiative as an expression of appreciation and loyalty to the governor, Udeh said the relationship between the group and Mbah went beyond the 2027 electioneering season. He pledged that ATM would deliver measurable results in support of APC candidates at all elective levels, particularly President Tinubu. Also speaking, the APC National Vice Chairman, South-East Zone, Dr Ijeomah Arodiogbu, commended Governor Mbah for his developmental strides in Enugu State and his efforts in coordinating the party’s presidential campaign activities in the South-East. Arodiogbu also praised Udeh for establishing the support group and his contributions to the Federal Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology. He called on the people of the South-East to support Tinubu’s re-election, while urging the people of Enugu State to vote for Mbah and all APC candidates in the 2027 elections. Using an apprenticeship analogy, the APC chieftain said no responsible father would send his son to learn a trade under a master who would not settle him after completing his apprenticeship. He argued that the South-East should support Tinubu because, according to him, the President understood the importance of rewarding loyalty and political support. Also speaking, the Enugu State Coordinator of ATM, Ugwuoke Onyebuchi, said the group comprised largely individuals who had previously been active in civil society rather than partisan politics. He said their decision to mobilise support for Mbah and Tinubu was informed by the confidence reposed in Udeh and their conviction that they could contribute to the state’s political and developmental direction. Ugwuoke said members would embark on grassroots mobilisation, voter education and engagement to persuade residents to support the APC candidates in the forthcoming elections. He added that the group would deploy technology and data-driven strategies to identify, classify and engage voters across communities, insisting that its activities and results would be measurable. The highlight of the event was the swearing-in of ATM members and executives at the state and local government levels by the Enugu State Commissioner for Youth and Sports, Barr. Lloyd Ekweremadu. The event was attended by the APC National Vice Chairman, South-East Zone, Dr Ijeomah Arodiogbu; former members of the House of Representatives, Hon U.S.A Igwesi, who is also the Enugu State Coordinator of Renewed Hope Ambassadors of Nigeria, and Hon Ogbuefi Ozomgbachi, Deputy Coordinator of the Presidential Campaign Council in the South-East. Others included the Chairman of the Enugu State Traditional Rulers Council, HRM Igwe Ikechukwu Asadu; local government chairmen; members of the Enugu State Executive Council; the state Chairman of the APC, Dr Martin Chukwunwike; and the APC South-East Women Leader, Dr Oby Ajih
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.title_zh: 2027年：Udeh为蒂努布、Mbah及其他APC候选人成立ATM支持团体
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 创新、科学与技术部长 Kingsley Udeh 博士于星期六正式为政治支持组织“随 Tinubu 和 Mbah 前进”（ATM）揭牌。该组织旨在动员支持总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu 竞选连任、恩古州州长 Peter Mbah 连任，以及进步大会党（APC）其他候选人在2027年大选中参选。这个以技术和创新为支柱的组织预计将利用数字工具动员选民、监测基层参与情况，并跟踪其在恩古州4,145个投票点的会员招募及选举动员活动。Mbah 州长在揭牌仪式上赞扬 Udeh 发起这一组织，称其技术路径和基层动员战略是 APC 现有政治体系在州内的重要补充。Mbah 对活动上人数众多感到兴奋，并敦促该组织成员把揭牌活动激发的热情延伸到全州各个社区、村庄、宗族、家庭和投票点。他说，支持组织是否有效，不能以揭牌仪式上的 crowds 人数衡量，而要看其能否将这股热情转化为基层动员和选举支持。他说：“ATM，这份热度、这股能量必须走出这间揭牌大厅。你们必须把这种能量带到我们的街道、村庄、投票点、宗族和家庭。”州长敦促组织成员通过看得见的发展项目及其政府的成就说服选民，包括智慧绿色学校、国际会议中心、总统酒店、国际医院及其他基础设施项目。谈及总统 Tinubu 寻求连任，Mbah 称总统是一位团结者，认为其政府的经济改革和基础设施投资为全国经济增长和共同繁荣奠定了基础。他说，总统取消燃油补贴并统一外汇制度的决定，展示了解决尼日利亚经济长期结构性挑战所需的政治勇气。据他介绍，尽管这些改革初期给民众带来困难，但它们是恢复宏观经济稳定、重建经济信心以及吸引私人资本和外国投资所必需的。Mbah 认为，持续推进经济改革对于把新出现的增长轨迹转化为就业机会、改善尼日利亚民众生活条件至关重要。他还强调联邦政府在东南部的基础设施建设，尤其是改善后的恩古—奥尼沙公路、正在推进的恩古—哈科特港高速公路项目，以及 Akanu Ibiam 国际机场的特许经营权转让。州长表示，机场特许经营将增强东南部的经济竞争力，尤其是在计划于2027年第一季度末前启动货运业务以及恩古与中国广州之间直飞航班之后。他坚持认为，鉴于目前从拉各斯经公路运往东南部的货物数量，该地区将显著受益于航空和货运处理能力的扩张。谈及2027年大选的政治影响，Mbah 敦促东南部民众采取战略性方式参与国家政治，强调在地区之外建立政治联盟的重要性。他回顾了第一共和国和第二共和国时期的政治联盟，特别是涉及 Nnamdi Azikiwe 博士和 Michael Okpara 博士的联盟，并将其作为跨地区政治合作如何推进伊博人利益的实例。州长认为，支持 Tinubu 寻求连任将为东南部提供加强自身政治影响力并深化参与国家治理的机会。尽管 APC 在该州政治体系中占据主导地位，Mbah 仍告诫该党成员不要自满，要求他们像处于劣势的一方那样积极竞选。Mbah 表示，该组织将与该州4,145个投票点的现有党组织体系形成互补，其数字监测平台将提供可核实基层动员情况的图景。他还敦促尚未领取永久选民卡（PVC）的合格选民及时领取，并为2027年1月16日的总统和国民议会选举以及2027年2月6日的州长和州议会选举开展动员。不过，州长强调政府的发展议程仍在推进之中，并指出贫困、供电不足、用水难题以及部分社区道路未铺装等问题意味着仍需开展更多工作。此前，ATM 召集人 Udeh 博士表示，由于该支持组织依靠技术、创新和数据驱动的选举动员方式，因此不同于传统政治组织。他透露，该组织已设立创新作战室和数字仪表板，用于监测会员登记、基层活动和投票点内的选民动员情况。据他介绍，会员登记将与持有 PVC 以及通过专门在线门户提交选民身份信息相联系，平台还将跟踪推荐和招募新会员的情况。Udeh 称，该项举措旨在用一个可信数据库取代未经核实的会员声明，使组织能够衡量自身表现并提供可核实报告。他还表示，Mbah 州长将可直接访问该仪表板，以监测活动、核实会员人数并评估组织进展。Udeh 将这项举措描述为对州长的感谢和忠诚，并称该组织与 Mbah 的关系超越了2027年选举竞选期。他承诺 ATM 将在各级选举中支持 APC 候选人，尤其是总统 Tinubu，并取得可衡量的成果。APC 东南部全国副主席 Ijeomah Arodiogbu 博士也在仪式上发言，赞扬 Mbah 州长在恩古州取得的发展成就，以及他在协调该党东南部总统竞选活动方面所做的努力。Arodiogbu 还赞扬 Udeh 成立支持组织，并对其在联邦创新、科学与技术部作出的贡献表示肯定。他呼吁东南部民众支持 Tinubu 寻求连任，同时敦促恩古州民众在2027年大选中投票支持 Mbah 和所有 APC 候选人。这位 APC 领导人以学徒制作比喻称，没有哪位负责任的父亲会把儿子送去跟随一位师傅学艺，却在儿子学成后不为其谋职安排。他 arguing 认为，东南部应支持 Tinubu，因为据他所说，总统懂得奖赏忠诚和政治支持的重要性。ATM 恩古州协调员 Ugwuoke Onyebuchi 也在仪式上表示，该组织主要由此前活跃于公民社会而非党派政治的人士组成。他说，他们决定动员支持 Mbah 和 Tinubu，是因为信任 Udeh，并坚信自己能够为州的政治和发展方向作出贡献。Ugwuoke 表示，成员将开展基层动员、选民教育和沟通工作，说服居民在即将举行的选举中支持 APC 候选人。他还表示，该组织将采用技术和数据驱动战略识别、分类并联系各个社区的选民，坚持其活动成果都可以衡量。活动的高潮是由恩古州青年与体育专员 Barr. Lloyd Ekweremadu 为 ATM 州级和地方政府层级的成员及执行人员主持宣誓就职。出席活动者包括 APC 东南部全国副主席 Ijeomah Arodiogbu 博士；尼日利亚众议院前议员、恩古州“ renewed hope ambassadors”协调员 U.S.A Igwesi 阁下，以及总统竞选委员会东南部副协调员 Ogbuefi Ozomgbachi 阁下。其他出席者还包括恩古州传统统治者委员会主席 HRM Igwe Ikechukwu Asadu；地方政府主席；恩古州执行委员会成员；APC 州主席 Martin Chukwunwike 博士；以及 APC 东南部妇女领袖 Oby Ajih 博士。

https://leadership.ng/2027-atiku-promise.body: Presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Atiku Abubakar, has promised to restore petroleum and electricity subsidies, tackle insecurity and sustain oil exploration in Kolmani if elected president in the 2027 general elections. Atiku made the promises on Saturday during the ADC presidential campaign rally held at the Abubakar Tafawa Balewa Stadium in Bauchi State. He said his administration, if elected, would prioritise restoring petroleum and electricity subsidies as part of measures to address the economic challenges facing Nigerians. The former vice president also pledged to restore security across the North-East and other parts of the country, assuring Nigerians that insecurity would receive serious attention under his leadership. Atiku further promised to sustain petroleum exploration activities in the Kolmani oil field to create additional sources of revenue for the country. He said, “I have already promised all Nigerians that I will restore petroleum subsidy. Not only that, I will also restore subsidy in power, electricity power. “Thirdly, I said I will restore security in the northern subregion and the country in general. On the forthcoming elections, Atiku urged ADC supporters to remain vigilant and ensure that their votes were protected, describing the exercise as essential to safeguarding their democratic rights. He called on voters to ensure that their votes were properly counted and that election results were transmitted before leaving their polling units. The ADC presidential candidate said the responsibility of protecting their votes should not be limited to the presidential election but should also cover elections into the National Assembly, state assemblies and local government councils. He urged the people of Bauchi State to come out in large numbers and vote for ADC candidates at all levels, from the presidency to councillorship positions. Atiku expressed appreciation to the people of Bauchi State for their continued support, describing the state as one of the areas that had given him some of the highest votes in previous elections. He assured them that he would not forget their loyalty, pledging to work towards addressing the country’s major challenges if given another opportunity to lead Nigeria. He also thanked Almighty God for granting him another opportunity to visit Bauchi State and seek the support of its people, assuring them that he would not take their continued loyalty for granted. https://leadership.ng/2027-atiku-promise.body_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）总统候选人阿提库·阿布巴卡尔承诺，如果在2027年大选中当选总统，将恢复石油和电力补贴、应对安全问题，并继续在Kolmani开展石油勘探。周六，阿提库在巴乌奇州Abubakar Tafawa Balewa体育场举行的ADC总统竞选集会上作出上述承诺。他说，如果当选，其政府将优先恢复石油和电力补贴，作为应对尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）所面临经济挑战的措施之一。这位前副总统还承诺恢复东北部及尼日利亚其他地区的安全，并向尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）民众保证，在其领导下，安全问题将得到严肃重视。阿提库进一步承诺继续在Kolmani油田开展石油勘探活动，为国家创造更多收入来源。他说：“我已经向所有尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）人承诺，将恢复石油补贴。不仅如此，我还将恢复电力和用电补贴。第三，我说过，我将恢复北部次区域及全国范围内的安全。关于即将举行的选举，阿提库敦促ADC支持者保持警惕，确保他们的选票得到保护，并称这一行动是维护其民主权利的关键。他呼吁选民在离开投票站前，确保选票得到正确计票，选举结果也已传送。该ADC总统候选人表示，保护选票的责任不应仅限于总统选举，还应涵盖国民议会、州议会和地方政府的选举。他敦促巴乌奇州民众大批出动，在从总统到议员职位的各级选举中投票支持ADC候选人。阿提库感谢巴乌奇州民众一直以来的支持，称该州是历次选举中给予他最高票数之一的地区。他向民众保证不会忘记他们的忠诚，并承诺如果再次获得领导尼日利亚（国家，首都阿布贾）的机会，将努力解决国家面临的主要挑战。他还感谢全能的上帝，让他有机会再次访问巴乌奇州并寻求当地民众的支持，并保证不会辜负他们始终如一的忠诚。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕消息和独家视角，直接送达你的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。立即在WhatsApp上加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，全天候获取最新动态 →

https://www.inquirer.net/495711/dfa-sout.body: Lazaro said about 80 percent of the paragraphs in the draft agreement had been completed following monthly negotiations between Asean and China. “At this point in time, 80 percent of the paragraphs … the document itself is finished. So there are just some sticking points,” Lazaro said in a press briefing at the International Media Center following a series of Asean ministerial meetings. She later clarified that the figure had been rounded up from about 70 percent, emphasizing that substantial progress had been achieved during the Philippines’ chairmanship of the regional bloc. On Friday, Foreign Affairs Assistant Secretary Dominic Xavier Imperial, the DFA spokesperson for Asean affairs, said about 70 percent of the proposed COC package had already been agreed upon. Imperial clarified that the figure represented the overall progress of negotiations rather than the proportion of paragraphs in the draft agreement approved by the parties. He declined to identify the provisions still under discussion and could not say whether negotiations would conclude before the Philippines’ Asean chairmanship ends this year. Lazaro likewise declined to identify the remaining contentious provisions, saying discussions were still ongoing. READ: Foreign leaders start arriving in Manila for 49th Asean Summit Asked whether the unresolved issues included making the agreement legally binding, she said it was difficult to pinpoint specific disagreements while negotiations continued. “Because of the continuing discussions on the matter, it’s very hard to pinpoint certain issues,” she said. Lazaro also declined to say whether the long-delayed agreement could be finalized during the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 17, stressing that she did not want to preempt President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and other regional leaders. “Let’s wait for the statement to come out,” she said when pressed on the possibility of concluding the agreement before the summit ends. She said Asean leaders were expected to issue a statement on the negotiations during the summit but declined to disclose its contents. Lazaro had identified four outstanding issues in the negotiations: the agreement’s legally binding nature, geographical scope, relationship with the 2002 Declaration on the Conduct of Parties in the South China Sea and terms of reference. Asean and China agreed in 2023 to accelerate negotiations and finalize the COC by 2026, with negotiators holding monthly discussions this year under the Philippines’ chairmanship. The proposed agreement seeks to establish rules to manage maritime disputes and prevent confrontations in the South China Sea, where China and several Southeast Asian countries have overlapping claims. The Philippines has maintained that the COC must be consistent with international law, particularly the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (Unclos), and must not undermine the rights of countries that are not parties to the agreement. The negotiations have taken on added significance amid continuing tensions between Manila and Beijing in the West Philippine Sea, where Chinese vessels have repeatedly challenged Philippine maritime operations. https://www.inquirer.net/495711/dfa-sout.title_zh: 外交部：南海行为准则已完成80%，但仍存在“难点”
https://www.inquirer.net/495711/dfa-sout.body_zh: 拉扎罗表示，在东盟与中国每月举行谈判后，协议草案约80%的条款已经完成。“就目前情况而言，80%的条款……文件本身已经完成。因此，只剩下一些难点。”拉扎罗在一系列东盟部长级会议后，于国际媒体中心的新闻发布会上说。她后来澄清称，这一数字是从约70%向上取整得出的，并强调菲律宾担任该地区组织主席国期间取得了实质性进展。周五，外交事务助理部长多米尼克·泽维尔·因佩里亚尔（Dominic Xavier Imperial）作为外交部负责东盟事务的发言人表示，拟议中的《行为准则》方案约70%已经达成共识。因佩里亚尔澄清称，这一数字代表谈判的总体进展，而非各方已经批准的协议草案条款比例。他拒绝透露仍在讨论的具体条款，也未说明谈判能否在菲律宾今年担任东盟主席国任期结束前完成。拉扎罗同样拒绝说明其余存在争议的条款，只表示讨论仍在继续。阅读：各国领导人开始抵达马尼拉，准备参加第49届东盟峰会。当被问及未解决的问题是否包括让协议具有法律约束力时，她说，在谈判持续期间，很难确定具体分歧。“由于相关事项仍在继续讨论，要明确确定某些问题非常困难。”拉扎罗还拒绝说明这项长期拖延的协议能否在11月15日至17日举行的第49届东盟峰会及相关峰会期间敲定，并强调她不想抢先于费迪南德·马科斯二世总统和其他地区领导人公布消息。当被追问能否在峰会结束前达成协议时，她说：“我们还是等声明出来吧。”她说，预计东盟领导人将在峰会期间就谈判发表声明，但拒绝透露声明内容。拉扎罗曾指出谈判中仍有四个悬而未决的问题：协议是否具有法律约束力、地理适用范围、与2002年《南海行为准则》之间的关系，以及职权范围。东盟与中国于2023年同意加快谈判，并在2026年前完成《行为准则》；今年，在菲律宾担任主席国期间，谈判人员每月举行讨论。拟议中的协议旨在制定管理海上争端、防止南海发生对抗的规则；中国和多个东南亚国家对南海存在重叠主张。菲律宾一直主张，《行为准则》必须符合国际法，特别是1982年《联合国海洋法公约》（Unclos），并且不得削弱未参与协议国家的权利。在马尼拉与北京围绕西菲律宾海紧张局势持续之际，谈判又增加了重要性；中国船只多次对菲律宾海上行动提出挑战。无法保存您的订阅。请重试。您的订阅已成功。尽管仍存在分歧，拉扎罗强调，菲律宾担任东盟主席国期间已经取得实质性进展。/mr

https://africa.businessinsider.com/local.summary: The United States has succeeded in cutting off China's crude oil shipments from Venezuela and displacing Chinese and Russian companies from several oilfields, while gaining control over more than $12 billion in natural resource revenues. The shift also affected oilfield operations in August, when North American Blue Energy Partners, controlled by Venezuelan billionaire Alejandro Betancourt, secured rights to operate 17 oilfields, including five previously run by Chinese companies and one by a Russian firm.
https://africa.businessinsider.com/local.summary_zh: 美国已成功切断中国从委内瑞拉获得的原油运输，并将中国和俄罗斯企业从多个油田排挤出去，同时取得了超过12亿美元自然资源的收入。这一变化还影响了8月份的油田运营，当时由委内瑞拉亿万富翁亚历杭德罗·贝坦库尔控股的北美蓝色能源伙伴公司取得了17个油田的经营权，其中包括此前由中国企业运营的5个油田和由一家俄罗斯企业运营的1个油田。
https://africa.businessinsider.com/local.body: The United States has succeeded in cutting off China's crude oil shipments from Venezuela and displacing Chinese and Russian companies from several oilfields, while gaining control over more than $12 billion in natural resource revenues. Russia has also lost part of its petroleum supply business to American companies, while a separate agreement in August transferred several previously Chinese- and Russian-operated oilfields to a US-backed company. China was previously Venezuela's biggest oil customer, receiving an average of 642,000 barrels per day of crude and fuel oil in 2025, accounting for 75% of the country's total daily exports of 847,000 barrels. However, the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) reported on November 6, 2026, that Venezuela had exported no crude oil to China during the year, with the United States replacing Beijing as its largest customer. American imports of Venezuelan crude reached 701,000 barrels per day in July, their highest level since May 2017, before easing to 655,000 barrels per day in August. More recent shipping data showed that Venezuela exported 1.08 million barrels per day of oil and petroleum products in October, with shipments to the US averaging 449,000 barrels daily, down nearly 29% from September. Russia has faced a similar shift, although its involvement centred more on petroleum supplies and oilfield investments than crude purchases. Moscow previously supplied about 100,000 metric tonnes of naphtha monthly, a product used to dilute Venezuela's heavy crude for transportation, before American suppliers took over much of that business in January 2026. The shift also affected oilfield operations in August, when North American Blue Energy Partners, controlled by Venezuelan billionaire Alejandro Betancourt, secured rights to operate 17 oilfields, including five previously run by Chinese companies and one by a Russian firm. Trump described the agreement as "the biggest oil deal in world history". Beyond securing access to Venezuela's oilfields, Washington has also taken control of how the country's natural resource revenues are distributed. A State Department report released on November 12 showed that the US handled $12.26 billion from Venezuelan crude oil, petroleum products, natural gas, gold, minerals and fertilisers between January and September 2026. Nearly 99% was transferred to Venezuela's interim government, although spending the funds still requires Washington's approval. While Washington tightens its grip on Venezuela's oil industry, its appetite for Nigerian crude has fallen sharply, as billionaire Aliko Dangote's refinery challenges American refiners for access to the country's prized oil supplies. Nigeria has long supplied the US with high-quality, low-sulphur crude, including Bonny Light and Qua Iboe, valued for producing petrol, diesel and aviation fuel. According to US Census Bureau figures cited by BusinessDay , American imports of Nigerian crude fell 57.8% to 14.01 million barrels between January and August 2026, from 33.23 million barrels during the same period in 2025. More recent EIA data showed a 91% weekly decline, from 136,000 barrels per day in the corresponding week of 2025 to 12,000 in the week ending November 6, 2026. Meanwhile, Dangote's refinery secured at least 16 million barrels of Nigerian crude in October, equivalent to 520,000 barrels per day. Total deliveries reached a record 735,000 barrels daily, with local grades accounting for 80%, according to Argus data. The refinery's expansion has also boosted Nigeria's seaborne refined petroleum exports from 46,000 barrels per day in 2023 to 350,000 in the second quarter of 2026, according to the EIA. American refiners now face growing competition from billionaire Aliko Dangote's refinery, as Nigeria shifts from exporting crude oil for processing abroad to refining more of it locally and selling finished petroleum products overseas
https://africa.businessinsider.com/local.title_zh: 随着美国掌控120亿美元委内瑞拉石油收入，中国和俄罗斯逐渐失去对委内瑞拉石油的控制，但仍面临一位亿万富翁对珍贵非洲原油的日益掌控
https://africa.businessinsider.com/local.body_zh: 美国已成功切断中国从委内瑞拉获取原油的渠道，并将中俄企业排挤出多个油田，同时掌控了超过120亿美元的自然资源收入。俄罗斯也将其部分石油供应业务拱手让给美国企业，另有一项于8月达成的协议将此前由中俄企业运营的多个油田转交一家获美国支持的公司。此前，中国是委内瑞拉最大的石油客户，2025年平均每天接收64.2万桶原油和燃料油，占该国每日84.7万桶原油出口总量的75%。然而，美国能源信息署（EIA）于2026年11月6日报告称，委内瑞拉当年未向中国出口任何原油，美国取代中国成为其最大客户。美国从委内瑞拉进口原油的日均数量在7月达到70.1万桶，创2017年5月以来最高水平，随后在8月回落至65.5万桶。更近期的航运数据显示，委内瑞拉10月平均每天出口108万桶石油和石油产品，其中对美出口日均44.9万桶，较9月下降近29%。俄罗斯也面临类似转变，但其利益更多集中于石油供应和油田投资，而非原油采购。此前，莫斯科每月供应约10万公吨石脑油；这种产品用于稀释委内瑞拉的重质原油以便运输。2026年1月，美国供应商接管了其中大部分业务。这一转变也影响了油田运营。8月，由委内瑞拉亿万富豪Alejandro Betancourt控制的北美Blue Energy Partners取得了17个油田的运营权，其中包括此前由5家中资企业运营的油田和1家俄资企业运营的油田。特朗普称该协议是“世界历史上最大的石油交易”。除确保进入委内瑞拉油田外，华盛顿还掌控了该国自然资源收入的分配方式。美国国务院11月12日发布的一份报告显示，2026年1月至9月，美国处理了来自委内瑞拉原油、石油产品、天然气、黄金、矿产和肥料的122.6亿美元收入。其中近99%已转交委内瑞拉临时政府，但动用这些资金仍须获得华盛顿批准。随着华盛顿加强对委内瑞拉石油业的控制，其对尼日利亚原油的兴趣却大幅下降，因为亿万富豪Aliko Dangote的炼厂正就获取该国优质原油供应与美国炼厂展开竞争。长期以来，尼日利亚一直向美国供应低硫高品质原油，其中包括Bonny Light和Qua Iboe。这些原油因可用于生产汽油、柴油和航空燃料而颇具价值。根据BusinessDay援引的美国人口普查局数据，2026年1月至8月，美国进口尼日利亚原油的数量从2025年同期的3323万桶下降57.8%至1401万桶。EIA更新的数据显示，美国进口量按周下降91%，从2025年同期每周13.6万桶降至截至2026年11月6日当周的1.2万桶。与此同时，Dangote的炼厂10月至少获得1600万桶尼日利亚原油，相当于每日52万桶。据Argus数据，该厂总交付量达到创纪录的每日73.5万桶，其中本地油品占80%。EIA称，该炼厂的扩建还推动尼日利亚海运精炼石油出口量从2023年的每日4.6万桶增至2026年第二季度的35万桶。随着尼日利亚从出口原油供海外加工转向在本地加工更多原油并向海外销售成品油，美国炼厂如今正面临来自亿万富豪Aliko Dangote旗下炼厂日益激烈的竞争。

He has denied any wrongdoing. Hungary's new Prime Minister Péter Magyar unseated Orbán in a landslide election in April on the promise of launching a sweeping anti-corruption drive. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/w.summary: An All Progressives Congress (APC) chieftain in Rivers State, Princewill Dike, has said the 700-member APC Presidential/Rivers Rainbow Coalition Candidates Campaign Council constituted by the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, is targeting at least four million votes for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 general election.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/w.summary_zh: Rivers State 的全进步大会党（APC）党魁普林威尔·戴克表示，由联邦首都地区（FCT）部长涅松·威克组建的700人APC总统选举暨河流州彩虹联盟候选人竞选委员会，正以在2027年大选中为博拉·提努布总统争取至少400万张选票为目标。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/w.body: An All Progressives Congress (APC) chieftain in Rivers State, Princewill Dike, has said the 700-member APC Presidential/Rivers Rainbow Coalition Candidates Campaign Council constituted by the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, is targeting at least four million votes for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 general election. Dike, who spoke in Port Harcourt on Friday, described the council as a strategic grassroots mobilisation structure designed to take the campaign beyond political rallies and directly engage voters across Rivers State. He said the council’s numerical strength should not be mistaken for a ceremonial political arrangement, stressing that its effectiveness would depend on members’ ability to translate their appointments into tangible grassroots mobilisation. According to him, Wike’s political approach is rooted in strategic organisation, coalition-building and sustained engagement with the electorate. “For Wike, politics is more than an occasional engagement; it is a calculated enterprise that demands constant attention, strategic thinking, organisation and an understanding of the dynamics of power,” Dike said. He explained that members of the council would be expected to embark on door-to-door campaigns and engage different segments of the electorate, including traders, transport operators and residents in their communities. “The objective is to ensure that political communication extends to every community where eligible voters reside,” he added. Dike said the initiative was intended to establish a formidable campaign network capable of reaching voters in every part of the state and persuading them to support Tinubu and candidates of the Rivers Rainbow Coalition. He noted that direct voter engagement, persuasion and personal political relationships would be critical to translating political structures into electoral victories. The APC chieftain also disclosed that Wike planned to establish campaign councils at the local government and ward levels to broaden participation and strengthen coordination from the state to the grassroots. Dike expressed optimism that effective implementation of the mobilisation strategy could deliver an unprecedented electoral performance for Tinubu and the Rivers Rainbow Coalition in 2027. However, he cautioned that the success of the 700-member council would depend not on its size but on the commitment and performance of its members. “A 700-member council can only justify its size when members demonstrate commitment, discipline, coordination and a willingness to engage voters at the community level,” he said. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/w.title_zh: 全进步人民党首领称，怀克的700人竞选委员会计划为蒂努布争取400万张选票
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/w.body_zh: 尼日利亚（尼日利亚，首都阿布贾）河州全进步大会党（APC）领导人Princewill Dike表示，由联邦首都领地（FCT）部长Nyesom Wike组建、拥有700名成员的“APC总统/河州彩虹联盟候选人竞选委员会”，计划在2027年大选中为总统Bola Tinobu争取至少400万张选票。Dike周五在哈科特Port Harcourt发表讲话，将该委员会称为一项战略性基层动员架构，旨在把竞选活动拓展到政治集会之外，直接接触河州各地选民。他说，不应将委员会庞大的人数误认为一种仪式性的政治安排，并强调其成效取决于成员能否将任命转化为切实的基层动员行动。据他介绍，Wike的政治路线以战略组织、建立联盟以及持续与选民互动为基础。Dike说：“对Wike而言，政治不仅仅是偶尔参与的活动，而是一项经过谋划的事业，需要持续关注、战略思维、组织能力以及对权力动态的理解。”他解释说，委员会成员应当开展挨家挨户的外展活动，并接触选民中的不同群体，包括商人、交通运营商和各自社区的居民。他补充道：“目标是确保政治沟通延伸到每一个有合格选民居住的社区。”Dike表示，这项倡议旨在建立一个强大的竞选网络，能够接触该州各地的选民，说服他们支持Tinobu以及河州彩虹联盟的候选人。他指出，直接接触选民、争取其支持以及建立个人政治关系，是把政治架构转化为选举胜利的关键。这名APC领导人还透露，Wike计划在地方政府一级和选区一级设立竞选委员会，以扩大参与范围，并加强从州级到基层的协调工作。Dike乐观认为，如果有效落实这项动员战略，Tinobu和河州彩虹联盟有望在2027年取得前所未有的选举佳绩。不过他警告说，700人委员会能否成功并不取决于其规模，而取决于成员的投入程度和工作表现。他说：“只有当成员展现出投入精神、纪律、协作以及在社区层面接触选民的意愿时，700人委员会才能证明其规模的价值。”THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚（尼日利亚，首都阿布贾）拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，并在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地以及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，THISDAY通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级受众，报道时事、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区议题，服务于社会与人交汇的领域，并充当新思想、文化和技术的交汇点，陪伴志向者与千禧一代共同成长。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: BEIJING — Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi elaborated on North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's recent visit to China during talks with his South Korean counterpart, a senior South Korean official said Saturday. The Chinese side explained Kim's trip to the Chinese border city of Dandong on Oct. 24 during Wang's talks with Foreign Minister Cho Hyun in Beijing on Friday, according to the foreign ministry official. "(The Chinese side) said that at a basic level, China's relations with North Korea are focused on economic cooperation rather than on political affairs," the official told reporters. "(We) were able to hear relatively detailed accounts." The official added the talks also touched on Wang's meeting with Kim Song-nam, a senior North Korean ruling party official, who visited Beijing last week. The official said the Chinese side also discussed the possibility of a U.S.-North Korea summit amid speculation over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Washington and Pyongyang. "My impression (after the talks) was that while there is a possibility, it is not that big," the official said, noting that it would likely depend on the U.S. situation and U.S. President Donald Trump's willingness. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 京畿道平泽——在1950年至1953年朝鲜战争结束70多年后，一批朝鲜战争老兵重返他们曾服役的美国陆军基地——这一次，他们是美国新一代士兵的尊贵客人。15岁志愿参军、随后在第八集团军野战医院协助照料受伤美国士兵的姜九健说：“感觉就像回到了家。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: PYEONGTAEK, Gyeonggi Province — More than seven decades after the 1950-53 Korean War, a group of Korean veterans returned to a U.S. Army base where they once served — this time as honored guests of a new generation of American soldiers. “It feels like coming home,” said Kang Ku-kon, who was 15 when he volunteered and began helping care for wounded American soldiers at an Eighth Army field hospital. “I served here 70 years ago. The moment I walked in, even the smell was the same.” Kang was among a group of Korean War veterans welcomed to Camp Humphreys in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, on Nov. 5. As their bus arrived at the Van Fleet Hall, a U.S. Army band began playing. For many of the visitors, now in their 90s, the trip offered a chance to see a place tied to their wartime service and meet the soldiers stationed there today. The visit grew out of a request from the veterans themselves. Vice Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kang Yun-jin said several veterans, including Ryu Jae-sik, head of the Korean War Veterans Association’s Seoul branch, raised the idea at a memorial event in Seoul attended by former U.S. military commanders and the ministry helped arrange the trip. “It was moving to see Eighth Army soldiers welcome our Korean War veterans with applause,” Kang said during the ceremony. “I am grateful to everyone who made this visit possible.” Lt. Gen. Joseph Hilbert, commander of the Eighth Army, paid tribute to the veterans for their service during the war. “The peace, prosperity and vibrant democracy we see across the Republic of Korea today did not happen by accident,” Hilbert said. “It was not guaranteed, but it was bought by and paid for by your courage, your sweat and your blood.” Departing from his prepared remarks, Hilbert said the sight of Seoul still reminded him of those who fought to defend the country. Every time he flies over the capital in a helicopter heading north, he said, he thinks of their sacrifice and what it made possible. The veterans then toured the headquarters, where photographs of those who fought in the Korean War line the walls. Some stopped when they recognized themselves or their comrades in the old pictures. One veteran pointed out a familiar face, prompting others to gather around. Several veterans then posed with Vice Minister Kang Yun-jin in front of the photographs, recreating the poses captured decades earlier. Hilbert wanted them to know that the display was not arranged for the occasion. “We didn’t put those pictures up for your visit,” he told them. “They’re here every day.” He said soldiers walking those corridors see the faces of the men who came before them, a daily reminder of the responsibility they carry. For Kang, the welcome brought back his years alongside American troops. He said he had come expecting to express his gratitude to the U.S. soldiers who helped defend South Korea, not to be thanked himself. “We should be the ones welcoming them, but instead they’re welcoming us,” he said. “I’m grateful.” Ryu, who enlisted at 18 and fought on the front lines, had a similar message. On the bus to Camp Humphreys, he urged his fellow veterans to remember the Americans who died or were wounded in the war and to see how today’s U.S. troops carry on their mission in Korea. The formal welcome was over, but an unexpected encounter awaited the veterans. While touring the base museum, the veterans came across a group of Korean noncommissioned officers (NCOs) taking part in a professional development program at the Army Special Warfare School. The younger soldiers saluted the veterans, then gathered with them for photographs. The two groups met again as the veterans prepared to leave. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 京畿道平泽——在1950年至1953年朝鲜战争结束70多年后，一组朝鲜战争老兵重返他们曾服役的美国陆军基地，而这一次，他们是新一代美国士兵的贵宾。15岁时应征入伍、开始在第八集团军野战医院协助照料伤员的美国兵的姜九功说：“感觉就像回家一样。70年前，我曾在这里服役。我走进去的那一刻，连气味都一模一样。”11月5日，姜九功是受到欢迎、来到京畿道平泽 Humphreys 营地的朝鲜战争老兵之一。巴士抵达 Van Fleet Hall 时，美国陆军军乐队开始奏乐。对许多如今已年逾90岁的来访者而言，此行让他们有机会看看与战时服役经历紧密相连的地方，并与驻扎在那里的当今士兵见面。这次访问源于老兵们自己的请求。祖国及退伍军人事务部副部长姜允镇说，包括朝鲜战争退伍军人协会首尔分会会长柳在锡在内的数名老兵，在首尔参加有美国前军事指挥官出席的纪念活动时提出了这一想法，随后该部协助安排了此次旅行。姜允镇在仪式上表示：“看到第八集团军士兵以掌声欢迎我们的朝鲜战争老兵，令人十分感动。我感谢所有促成这次访问的人。”第八集团军司令约瑟夫·希尔伯特中将向老兵们致敬，表彰他们在战争期间的服役经历。希尔伯特说：“我们今天在韩国看到的和平、繁荣和充满活力的民主并非偶然。它并非唾手可得，而是用你们的勇气、汗水和鲜血换来的，并用生命付出了代价。”希尔伯特在准备好的讲话之外还说，每次看到首尔，他仍会想起那些为保卫这个国家而战斗的人。他说，每当乘直升机向北飞越首都时，他都会想起他们的牺牲，以及这种牺牲所促成的成果。随后，老兵们参观了司令部，墙上陈列着参加朝鲜战争者的照片。有些人在旧照片中认出自己或战友后停了下来。一名老兵指出一张熟悉的面孔，其他人随即围拢过来。数名老兵接着在照片前与副部长姜允镇合影，重现数十年前镜头中记录的姿态。希尔伯特希望他们知道，这些照片并非为了此次访问才布置出来。他告诉他们：“我们并不是为了你们来访才挂上这些照片的。它们每天都在这里。”他说，士兵们走过那些走廊时，会看到前辈们的面孔，这每天都提醒着他们肩负的责任。对姜九功而言，这次欢迎让他想起与美军并肩作战的岁月。他说，自己原本是来向帮助保卫韩国的美国士兵表达感谢，而不是来接受他们的感谢。他说：“应该由我们欢迎他们，但最后是他们欢迎我们。我深感感激。”18岁入伍并在前线作战的柳在锡也expressed类似的心声。在前往 Humphreys 营地的巴士上，他敦促 fellow veterans 铭记在战争中阵亡或负伤的美国人，并看看今天的美国军队如何继续在韩国履行使命。正式欢迎仪式结束后，老兵们还意外迎来了一次相遇。参观基地博物馆时，他们遇到一群正在陆军特种作战学校参加专业发展项目的韩国士官。年轻士兵向老兵敬礼，随后与他们一起合影。老兵准备离开时，双方再次相遇。士官们站在即将驶离的车辆两侧敬礼……

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.title: Federal Ministry of Finance’s Draft Nigeria Economic Policy Framework: Can It Deliver More Than Another Document?
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.summary: The challenge of economic policy is to connect these realities: to turn stability into opportunity, stronger revenue into effective services and reform into better living standards. That should be the central test of the Federal Ministry of Finance’s draft Nigeria Economic Policy Framework. One of its strongest proposals is a Policy Impact Statement for every major economic intervention.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.summary_zh: 经济政策的挑战在于将这些现实衔接起来：把稳定转化为机遇，把更强的财政收入转化为有效的公共服务，把改革转化为更高的生活水平。这应当成为联邦财政部《尼日利亚经济政策框架》草案的核心检验标准。其中最有力的建议之一，是为每项重大经济干预措施制定政策影响声明。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/14/f.body: A government can improve its accounts while families struggle to balance theirs. Investment announcements can increase while businesses face high operating costs. Economic indicators can strengthen before citizens experience meaningful relief. The challenge of economic policy is to connect these realities: to turn stability into opportunity, stronger revenue into effective services and reform into better living standards. That should be the central test of the Federal Ministry of Finance’s draft Nigeria Economic Policy Framework. The consultation, which opened on October 26 and closes on November 27, proposes enduring principles, decision rules and performance measures for economic policymaking across successive administrations. It remains a draft, open to public comment. The initiative deserves serious engagement. Businesses benefit from predictable policies. Households need confidence that the costs of reform have been considered. Public institutions need clear responsibilities and consistent standards against which their performance can be assessed. The question is whether this framework will establish those disciplines in practice. One of its strongest proposals is a Policy Impact Statement for every major economic intervention. This would examine the evidence, available alternatives, distributional effects, fiscal implications, implementation capacity, performance indicators and exit conditions. The draft also proposes public scorecards and independent reviews. These provisions could improve government decisions. Their effectiveness, however, depends on when assessments are published, how thoroughly they are scrutinised and what happens when officials disregard them. Except in clearly defined emergencies, impact statements should appear before implementation. Citizens and businesses need an opportunity to examine assumptions and raise concerns while changes remain possible. The final framework should also define a major intervention carefully. Budgetary cost is only one consideration. A regulatory restriction may cost government little while substantially increasing expenses for businesses and consumers. The number of people affected and the severity of the consequences should also determine the level of scrutiny. Additional receipts can finance investment, reduce debt, settle outstanding obligations or strengthen savings. But temporary gains can also encourage commitments that become difficult to sustain when prices or production decline. A sound framework should require government to distinguish exceptional receipts from dependable income. It should explain how additional resources will be used, disclose the risks and identify the benefits citizens should expect. The same approach should apply to tax incentives and industrial protection. Support should have a clear economic purpose, measurable outcomes and a review date. Where benefits fail to materialise, government should be prepared to revise or withdraw it. Consistency must nevertheless leave room for democratic choice. Future administrations should retain the authority to change policies in response to evidence, public preferences and economic circumstances. The lasting obligation should be to justify decisions transparently and assess their consequences. Any legislation arising from the framework should therefore strengthen standards of evidence, consultation, disclosure and evaluation. It should avoid making one administration’s preferred economic choices unnecessarily difficult to reconsider. Emergency flexibility is also essential. Government may sometimes need to act quickly. In such cases, it should publish the justification, estimated cost, duration and arrangements for subsequent review. Extensions should require fresh evidence. Digital governance can help make these requirements workable. Each major intervention should have an accessible public record connecting its assessment, budget, responsible institution, implementation milestones and evaluation findings. Consistent identifiers would make it easier to follow a policy from approval through expenditure to results. Public dashboards should be supported by downloadable data, clear methodologies and revision histories. Researchers and journalists must be able to examine the evidence behind official conclusions. Personal information, particularly that of vulnerable beneficiaries, should remain protected. Independent scrutiny is equally important. Statistical measurement, financial audit and policy evaluation perform different functions. Their responsibilities should be explicit, and the institutions involved should have the authority and resources to publish findings without undue interference. The framework must also specify what follows when an institution fails to comply. Published corrective action plans, responsible officials and deadlines would provide a practical starting point. Ultimately, household welfare should carry substantial weight in assessing economic performance. Growth, revenue and investment are important foundations. Progress must also be visible in purchasing power, employment quality, poverty reduction and access to functioning schools, healthcare and other essential services. Where reliable data permit, national results should be broken down to show differences across regions and population groups. An improving average can conceal persistent hardship. Implementation will require clear ownership, adequate capacity and realistic milestones. Existing reporting systems should be strengthened, with states and local governments involved within their constitutional responsibilities. The consultation offers an early opportunity to demonstrate that approach. The Ministry should explain how public submissions influenced the final framework. Nigeria needs economic rules that improve decisions and make results easier to verify. The framework’s value will become clear when its standards shape everyday government practice and when citizens across the country begin to experience the benefits. 在家庭苦苦维持收支平衡之际，政府却可能改善其财政状况。在企业面临高运营成本之际，投资公告数量可能增加。在公民切实感受到实质性纾困之前，经济指标也可能走强。经济政策面临的挑战，是将这些现实状况连接起来：把稳定转化为机遇，把更高的财政收入转化为有效的公共服务，把改革转化为更好的生活水平。这应当成为尼日利亚联邦财政部《尼日利亚经济政策框架》草案的核心检验标准。此次咨询于10月26日启动、11月27日结束，拟为历届政府连续制定经济政策确立持久有效的原则、决策规则和绩效衡量标准。该文件目前仍为草案，并向公众征求意见。这一举措值得认真参与。企业受益于可预测的政策。家庭需要确信，改革成本已经得到充分考虑。公共机构需要明确的职责和一致的标准，以便据此评估其绩效。关键问题在于，这一框架能否在实践中确立这些规范。其最有力的提案之一，是要求每项重大经济干预措施均提交政策影响说明。相关说明应审查证据、可选方案、分配效应、财政影响、执行能力、绩效指标和退出条件。草案还提议引入公开评分卡和独立评估。这些规定可以改善政府决策。然而，其成效取决于评估结果何时公布、受审查的程度，以及官员无视评估结果时会发生什么。除在明确定义的紧急情况下，政策影响说明都应在实施前公布。公民和企业需要有机会审查各项假设并提出疑虑，而此时政策调整仍有空间。最终框架还应审慎界定何谓重大干预措施。预算成本只是考量因素之一。监管限制可能几乎不增加政府成本，却会大幅提高企业和消费者的开支。受影响人数和后果严重程度也应决定审查的深度。额外收入可以为投资提供资金、减少债务、清偿未决义务或增强储蓄。但暂时性收益也可能助长难以持续兑现的承诺，尤其是在价格或产量下降时。稳健的框架应要求政府区分异常收入与可持续收入。框架应说明额外资源将如何使用，披露相关风险，并明确公民可以期待哪些益处。同样的方法也应适用于税收优惠和产业保护。扶持措施应具有明确的经济目的、可衡量的成果和审查日期。如果预期收益未能实现，政府应准备修订或撤销相关措施。不过，一致性仍须为民主选择留有空间。未来政府应保留根据证据、公众偏好和经济形势调整政策的权力。长期责任应落在透明地论证决策并评估其后果上。因此，源自该框架的任何立法，都应强化证据、协商、披露和评估标准，不应让一届政府偏好的经济选择变得难以重新审议。紧急情况下的灵活性同样不可或缺。政府有时可能需要迅速采取行动。在这种情况下，政府应公布行动理由、估算成本、持续时间以及后续审查安排。延长措施应要求提供新的证据。数字治理有助于使这些要求切实可行。每项重大干预措施都应建立易于访问的公开记录，将评估、预算、责任机构、实施里程碑和评估结果相互关联。采用统一标识符，将有助于追踪一项政策从批准、支出到最终成果的全过程。公开仪表板应由可下载数据、清晰的方法说明和修订记录提供支持。研究人员和记者必须能够审查官方结论背后的证据。个人信息，尤其是弱势受益人的个人信息，应受到保护。独立监督同样重要。统计测量、财务审计和政策评估承担着不同职能。相关机构的职责应明确界定，并应赋予相关机构权力和资源，使其能够在不受不当干预的情况下公布评估结果。框架还必须规定机构未能遵守要求时的后续处理。公布整改行动计划、责任人及完成期限，可以提供切实可行的起点。归根结底，评估经济表现时，家庭福利应占据重要分量。增长、财政收入和投资是重要基础。进展还应体现在购买力、就业质量、贫困减少，以及获得正常运转的学校、医疗保健和其他基本服务等方面。在可靠数据允许的情况下，全国性成果应细分列示，以显示不同地区和人口群体之间的差距。平均指标的改善可能掩盖长期存在的困苦。实施该框架需要明确责任归属、充足能力和切合实际的里程碑。现有报告体系应得到加强，各州和地方政府应在宪法规定的职责范围内参与其中。此次咨询提供了尽早展示这种做法的机会。财政部应说明公众意见如何影响了最终框架。尼日利亚需要能够改善决策并使成果更易核实的经济规则。当该框架的标准切实影响日常政府实践，并开始让全国各地的公民感受到其益处时，其价值便会清晰显现。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY MANILA, Philippines – Thousands of students from different parts of the Philippines staged protests on Friday, November 13, against the US-led Pax Silica initiative and US President Donald Trump’s expected arrival in the country for the ASEAN Summit. Filipinos have raised concerns about the initiative’s potential environmental impact and the possible displacement of indigenous peoples and farming communities. In Manila, students from the University of Santo Tomas (UST), Asia’s oldest Catholic university, walked out of their classrooms to join the protest. “Pax Silica is reported to generate hundreds of thousands of indirect and induced jobs. However, projections are not promises and promises are not guarantees, especially when dealing with a global power like the United States,” the UST Central Student Council Executive Board said. “It is not enough to ask what development Pax Silica can offer; we must also ask who stands to benefit from it, and more importantly, who will bear its costs,” it added. At De La Salle University, at least 1,500 students also walked out of their classrooms to protest against the initiative. Students from different campuses of the University of the Philippines, Polytechnic University of the Philippines, Miriam College, and Ateneo de Manila University also joined the demonstrations. In Benguet, around 9,000 students from various schools, including UP Baguio, Saint Louis University, and the University of the Cordilleras took to the streets to express their opposition to Pax Silica. Students from Central Luzon State University also staged a protest on Thursday, November 12. The signing of the Pax Silica agreement had reportedly been targeted for November, coinciding with Trump’s visit to the Philippines for the ASEAN Summit. However, Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo clarified that the Philippines would not sign the agreement during the 49th ASEAN Summit. “We do not want to distract attention or take away attention from the regional initiatives that ASEAN and the Philippines are proposing,” Rodolfo told reporters on Tuesday, November 10. Amid the protests, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro appealed to the public to reconsider holding demonstrations during the summit. “’ Kung ano man ang panawagan ito ay sana hindi dinadaan sa pagprotesta although ito ay kanilang karapatan. Pero sa panahon ngayon mas magandang nagkakaroon ng mas masinsinang paguusapan kung ano man ang concerns ng mga estudyante ,” Castro said during a press briefing on Saturday, November 14. (Whatever their demands may be, I hope these are not pursued through protests, although I recognize that this is their right. In these times, however, it would be better to have more in-depth discussions about whatever concerns the students may have.) Different groups are also expected to stage protests in different parts of the country in succeeding days, coinciding with the ASEAN Summit. – Rappler.com Upgrade to Rappler+ for exclusive content and unlimited access

https://www.politico.eu/article/us-sugge.body: The U.S. has floated the idea of Ukraine joining NATO in exchange for withdrawing from its eastern Donbas region as part of negotiations to end the war, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Friday. “The Americans raised a question: ‘What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?’ This was the first time this had been raised,” Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday, a day after he met with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Dublin . The Donbas region in Ukraine’s far east borders Russia, and Moscow declared it had annexed the region in 2022 after its full-scale invasion. The vast majority of the region is occupied by Russian troops. Giving up Donbas has long been part of the proposals put forward by U.S. President Donald Trump's administration, including the 28-part plan for a peace agreement proposed by the White House in 2025 . Russian President Vladimir Putin has previously demanded that Ukraine abandon its efforts to join NATO and accept strict limits on the size of its military. “I have said repeatedly: Ukraine is not retreating and is not giving up its land to terrorists,” Zelenskyy told reporters. The White House and U.S. State Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Zelenskyy said he was discussing a “comprehensive security package” with partners that would include specific guarantees from NATO and the EU, a strong Ukrainian army with adequate troops, weapons and financial support for a set period and a recovery plan with clear funding attached. “If the American side confirms precisely this to us, together with other NATO partners, then I will ask our Ukrainian society what it thinks: do we accept it or not? I have no right to make that decision on my own,” Zelenskyy said. "Of course, this would be without any recognition of the occupied territories as Russian," he added. “But we need specifics, and we don't have them yet. All of this is still under discussion,” the president said

https://www.politico.eu/article/us-sugge.body_zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基周五表示，美国提出了一种设想：作为结束战争的谈判的一部分，可以用乌克兰加入北约来交换其从东部顿巴斯地区撤军。泽连斯基周五在接受记者采访时说：“美国人提出了一个问题：‘如果乌克兰加入北约，乌克兰是否会撤出顿巴斯？’这是第一次有人提出这个问题。”此前一天，他曾在都柏林会见美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳。顿巴斯位于乌克兰最东部，与俄罗斯接壤；莫斯科在2022年全面入侵乌克兰后宣布吞并该地区。该地区绝大部分目前由俄罗斯军队占领。长期以来，放弃顿巴斯一直是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府提出的方案之一，包括白宫于2025年提出的28项和平协议计划。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京此前要求乌克兰放弃加入北约的努力，并接受对其军队规模的严格限制。泽连斯基对记者说：“我已经反复说过：乌克兰不会撤退，也不会把自己的土地拱手让给恐怖分子。”白宫和美国国务院没有立即回应置评请求。泽连斯基表示，他正在与合作伙伴讨论一项“全面安全方案”，其中将包括北约和欧盟提供的具体保障、一支拥有充足兵员和武器并在一定时期内获得资金支持的强大乌克兰军队，以及一项附有明确资金安排的重建计划。泽连斯基说：“如果美方能向我们明确确认这整套方案，并确认会与其他北约伙伴一道实施，那么我会询问乌克兰社会对此的看法：我们接受还是不接受？我无权独自作出这个决定。”他补充道：“当然，这不会以承认被占领领土属于俄罗斯为前提。”总统说：“但我们需要具体内容，而目前尚未具备。所有这些仍在讨论之中。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/petrol-tippe.body: Petrol prices could fall by up to 8.23% from November 16, 2026, while diesel prices are also expected to decline, according to the Chamber of Oil Marketing Companies (COMAC). However, consumers of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) face a projected 21.10% increase per kilogram during the second pricing window of November. COMAC’s outlook points to lower international petrol and diesel prices, alongside a slowdown in the cedi’s depreciation. The projected LPG increase reflects the delayed impact of higher international prices from the previous pricing window. Data from COMAC indicates petrol could sell at GH¢15.62 per litre after the projected reduction. Diesel prices could fall by 1.79% to 4.42%, bringing the price to about GH¢18 per litre. These are projections, with actual retail prices dependent on the pricing decisions of individual marketing companies. COMAC attributes the expected reductions in petrol and diesel prices largely to falling international refined-product prices. Crude oil prices fell 16.14% to US$104.25 per barrel during the review period, marking their first significant drop since August 2026. According to the chamber, the decline reflected easing geopolitical risks, expectations of de-escalation in the Middle East and a recovery in OPEC+ output to 41.23 million barrels per day. International petrol prices fell 16.30%, while diesel fell 5.13%. LPG prices also dropped by 6.42%. Despite the international LPG decline, COMAC expects domestic prices to rise because earlier increases under the tender arrangement have not yet passed through. The chamber also noted that the cedi depreciated by just 0.15% between October 28 and November 11, limiting exchange-rate pressure on fuel prices. Meanwhile, the government–industry intervention continues to cushion diesel consumers against price pressures. Some oil marketing companies have already reduced petrol and diesel prices ahead of the November 16 window. It remains unclear whether they will make further adjustments in line with COMAC’s projections. Star Oil has reduced prices three times over the past week and is selling petrol at GH¢15.55 per litre and diesel at GH¢18.37 per litre. Allied is selling petrol at GH¢15.50 per litre and diesel at GH¢18.20. JP has also lowered its petrol price from GH¢16.43, quoted on October 16, to GH¢15.95. Its diesel price has fallen from GH¢18.97 to GH¢18.35. These adjustments mean some petrol prices are already below COMAC’s projected GH¢15.62 per litre. Petroleum pricing reviews take place on the first and 16th of each month. The National Petroleum Authority (NPA) has set minimum price floors of GH¢13.69 per litre for petrol and GH¢16.73 per litre for diesel. These figures are minimum benchmarks, not final retail prices. According to the NPA, they exclude premiums charged by International Oil Trading Companies, operating margins of Bulk Import, Distribution and Export Companies, and margins charged by Oil Marketing Companies and LPG Marketing Companies. The respective companies will determine those charges independently under the prescribed Petroleum Products Pricing Formula
https://www.myjoyonline.com/petrol-tippe.title_zh: 汽油价格预计将下跌8.23%，但液化石油气价格将上涨21%
https://www.myjoyonline.com/petrol-tippe.body_zh: 据石油营销商协会（COMAC）消息，自2026年11月16日起，汽油价格可能下调最多8.23%，柴油价格预计也将下降。然而，在11月第二个定价窗口期内，液化石油气（LPG）消费者预计每公斤将面临21.10%的涨价。COMAC的展望显示，国际汽油和柴油价格走低，同时塞地贬值速度放缓。预计LPG涨价反映了上一定价窗口国际油价上涨的滞后影响。COMAC的数据显示，汽油在预计降价后可能以每升GH¢15.62的价格出售。柴油价格可能下降1.79%至4.42%，降至每升约GH¢18。这些数字仅为预测，实际零售价格取决于各家营销公司的定价决定。COMAC认为，汽油和柴油价格预计下降主要是由于国际成品油价格下跌。评估期内，原油价格下跌16.14%，降至每桶US$104.25，这是自2026年8月以来的首次显著跌幅。该协会表示，这一跌幅反映出地缘政治风险缓解、市场预期中东局势降级，以及OPEC+产量回升至每日4123万桶。国际汽油价格下跌16.30%，柴油价格下跌5.13%，LPG价格也下跌了6.42%。尽管国际LPG价格下降，COMAC预计国内价格仍将上涨，因为此前在招标安排下实施的涨价尚未传导至零售端。该协会还指出，10月28日至11月11日期间，塞地仅贬值0.15%，限制了汇率对燃油价格造成的压力。与此同时，政府与行业采取的干预措施继续缓冲柴油消费者面临的价格压力。一些石油营销公司已在11月16日定价窗口前下调汽油和柴油价格。它们是否会根据COMAC的预测进一步调整价格，目前尚不清楚。Star Oil在过去一周已三次降价，目前汽油售价为每升GH¢15.55，柴油售价为每升GH¢18.37。Allied的汽油售价为每升GH¢15.50，柴油售价为GH¢18.20。JP也已将汽油价格从10月16日公布的GH¢16.43降至GH¢15.95，柴油价格则从GH¢18.97降至GH¢18.35。这些调整意味着，部分汽油价格已经低于COMAC预计的每升GH¢15.62。石油产品定价评估每月1日和16日进行。国家石油管理局（NPA）设定汽油最低价格下限为每升GH¢13.69，柴油最低价格下限为每升GH¢16.73。这些数字是最低基准，而非最终零售价格。NPA表示，这些数字不包括国际石油交易公司收取的溢价、散装进口、分销与出口公司的运营利润，以及石油营销公司和LPG营销公司收取的利润。相关公司将根据规定的石油产品定价公式自行确定这些费用

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Washington had proposed the idea of Ukraine ceding land to Russia in exchange for NATO membership as efforts to bring an end to the war continue. "The Americans raised a question: 'What if Ukraine joins NATO? Would Ukraine withdraw from Donbas?' This was the first time this had been raised," Zelenskyy told reporters on Friday in comments embargoed until Saturday, the AFP news agency reported. Zelenskyy added that Ukraine was discussing "specific security guarantees" from NATO and the European Union and that he would ask Ukrainians if they accepted the terms should Western nations confirm. It comes after Russian President Vladimir Putin met with US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Moscow earlier this week. During their meeting, Putin signalled that Russia would not back down on territorial demands to control parts of Ukraine and rejected the idea of foreign peacekeeping troops being deployed in the country. The US envoys later met with Zelenskyy in Ireland on Thursday to discuss ongoing diplomatic efforts, with the trio announcing that, moving forward, Europe would have a "voice" in peace negotiations. "This will allow us to address the broader postwar European security arrangements alongside the territorial issues between Ukraine and Russia," Kushner wrote in a post on X. "They are striving by every means possible to join the negotiations, but, as our President has said, they must decide whether they want peace or the continuation of the war," he said
